description: "**Flux Sight is a passive. It does not wait to be asked.** With The Unmeasured equipped it began returning ceilings the moment it applied (Section 16.3: from the next resolved action, never retroactively), and he swept the entire inventory in twenty minutes. **The first genuinely new information he has had about his own possessions in weeks**, and it is recorded holding-by-holding in `120_INVENTORY_AND_OWNERSHIP.md`.

  **THE FINISHED DAGGER [S] IS AT ITS CEILING. It is finished.** No remaining headroom, no infusion will take, nothing further can be added by any hand.

  **Which answers a question nobody had thought to ask.** Marnie's loading dock at `EVT-000326` was a workspace abandoned mid-job - a half-finished leather piece, loose tool components, raw salvage in the middle of being worked. **Everything on that bench was interrupted except this.** She took an S-Rank blade all the way to its ceiling, put it down, and never came back for it. Whatever happened to her happened **after** she finished it, and the name it auto-identified under was accurate rather than optimistic.

  **AND THE HALF-FINISHED LEATHER PIECE IS NOT A SCRAP.** Carried since 2026-08-13 in the `special` group as evidence, next to a work order and a torn visitor badge, kept because it was hers rather than because it was worth anything. **Ceiling NOT reached, substantial headroom: it is an incomplete [A-RANK] armour piece, stopped partway, and it can still be completed by a hand good enough to read what was already done to it.** Two hours before an appointment with the one artificer in Chicago who has held that maker's work, identified her tic across three objects at three difficulty grades, and said she would know the hand again anywhere.

  **The Combat Tier S question answered flatly, in both directions.** **Gale Hunter's Gauntlets [C] and Arcanist Feet [C] are BOTH AT CEILING - finished, no upgrade path, by any hand.** They are the two 8% pieces and the weakest links in a multiplicative chain, and they cannot be improved, only replaced. **But the Adaptive Titan Coif [B], Watcher Torso [B] and Adaptive Titan Legs [B] all carry headroom and are raisable to [A]** - and the Torso's Carapaced imprint deepens with it. So Tier S through armour is **artificer work on three pieces plus outright purchase of two**, which is a materially different plan from the shopping trip it looked like an hour earlier.

  **The Mana Reservoir [C] has been running at 42% of what it is for.** Capacity 125, charge 17 - and the housing **was built to carry a B-Rank pool**. Bought from Walt Adamik for $2,500 at `EVT-000446` and under-used since the day it was acquired. Raising it is artificer work, and he is carrying **twenty [B-Rank] beast cores the System shop refuses to touch** and has shown Priscilla Nakamura none of them.

  **The Elixir of a stat, and a question he had put to the Runtime an hour earlier.** **Ceiling: +3 to a chosen Stat, permanent. That is its whole capacity and it cannot be made to give more.** It is Daily Premium stock, one per cycle - which is where this one was bought at `EVT-000548` for 5,000 g - so it is **+3 a day at 5,000 gold**, not a lever that 367,501 gold pulls seventy-three times. The Runtime had flagged that it did not know the magnitude and would not guess it; the sweep read it.

  **The Warded Vambraces are at ceiling - the -30% is all there is**, no stat line and no headroom, which is exactly why Walt sat on one for nine days and let it go at $3,000. **The Ghost Quickknife [A] carries headroom to [S]**, as do the Ghost Quickknife [B], the Quickknife [B], the Longsword [B] and the Reacharm [B]. **The Unlicensed Lockpick Set [B] is raisable to [A]** - *effective up to B-Rank* turns out to be a current state rather than a design limit. At ceiling and finished: the Warlord's Loop [A], Mindspun Loop [C], Hunter's Band [D], Quickknife [C], the document wallet, sensor rig, Suppression Emitter and Gate Direction Finder."
```

Twenty-five were allocated, and the tenth through twenty-fifth went to Intelligence.** The stored Stats have said so since the moment they were written and nothing read them back: base Intelligence closes **488** where automatic growth alone reaches **478**. The ten-point gap is allocation, it is already in effective Intelligence 491, already in `maximum_mana` 982, and already in every damage figure derived this span — Rupture's 3,715 and Mana Bolt's 1,034 both read 491 and are unaffected.

At Checkpoint 0103 they stand **441/417/499/418/488** at level 40. Three level crossings at the Section 3.2 **B rung pay +23 to every Stat**, so automatic growth accounts for **+69 across the board** and no more. Strength, Agility and Perception close at exactly +69 and are pure automatic growth. **Vitality closes +84 (+15 allocated) and Intelligence +79 (+10 allocated)** — twenty-five points, against a stored `unspent_points` of **0**.

  **The pool balances exactly, which is what makes this a bookkeeping failure rather than a missing grant.** Available across the span: **5** banked at level 37, **+5** at each of levels 38, 39 and 40 under Section 3.2, and **+5 from Vanguard's [Rare] grade payment** under Section 16.1's `+2 Common / +5 Rare / +10 Singular` ladder. **25 available, 25 allocated, 0 unspent.** Nothing was created and nothing was lost; the Bearer spent exactly what he was owed.

No point is granted by this correction — the +5 was already in the pool and is already spent.

Only `progression.xp_total` and the `skills.*` paths are `tracked_counters` under Decision 079's `baseline + sum(counter_deltas) = current_value`, so the AP ledger is the one growth axis in this campaign with no arithmetic gate behind it — a rendered string, and a rendered string has nothing to disagree with. This is `F-017`'s shape on a different axis: XP went untracked across an entire instant dungeon until the player asked where it was, and the remedy there was making it a counter. **Recorded as owed rather than done: AP has no counter and this correction does not give it one.**

## EVT-000595 - Rendering Drift: Two Baselines Derived Instead of Read, and Three Surfaces That Never Heard the Correction

```yaml

canonical_record: REC-000079

status: active
provenance:
  source: session-gameplay

    domain: gatefall.skill_formation
    result: none
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_credit
    result: none
description: "**Five rendering defects, found by reconciling every stored skill value against the profile it derives from.** No roll is re-run, **no past outcome is altered**, and no counter, Rank, mastery level or floor moves. Two of the five change a standing damage figure going forward; three were prose disagreeing with something already correct beside it.

  **1. Rupture's S-Rank baseline was 938. Section 7.2 authors 1,000.** 938 is `375 × 2.5` — the A-Rank row multiplied by the table's own step — which is how the table was *built* and not what it *says*. **DMG 3,715 → 3,877** at effective Intelligence 491 (`(1,000+491)×2.60 = 3,876.6`). `magnitude_floor` 260 still binds and does not move; the S-Rank Adept authored ×2.30 is still the losing side of it.

  **2. Mana Bolt's B-Rank baseline was 155. Section 7.2 authors 150.** Same cause, one row lower: `62 × 2.5`. **The same skill line was also a whole span stale**, rendering effective Intelligence **412** and DMG **907** from the level-37 figures while the Record beside it carried 491 and 1,034. Both corrected together: **DMG 1,026** at effective Intelligence 491 (`(150+491)×1.60 = 1,025.6`).

  **Every past outcome stands.** Mana Bolt has resolved against live bodies at the 155 baseline since `EVT-000586`, worth 8 damage on a strike near 1,000 — those rolls resolved under the figure in force and are not re-run, on the same rule the 1.80 backfill applied to a far larger change. Rupture's [S] rung was taken at `EVT-000590`, after the span's last fight, so **3,715 was never used against anything.** **Combat Tier is unaffected**: `offense_tier` was already S and cannot rise, `defense_tier` holds at A, and Section 6.7 takes the lower axis — **Combat Tier A**.

  **3. Keen Sense read 10 subjects where the formula returns 9.** The line computed `5 + 4 = 9` correctly and then rendered it as *himself plus 9 allies*, counting the Bearer twice. Section 7.2's scope is a count of **subjects** and Section 7.4's ladder benefits *the Bearer alone* at Novice, so 9 is **himself plus 8**. The rendering was right at [B-Rank] — *himself plus 7, 8 subjects*, on `scope_floor` 8 — and drifted on the A-Rank Master crossing at Checkpoint 0100. **`scope_floor` 8, `rank_ascensions` 4 and every counter are untouched.**

  **4. Resonance Extraction rendered a `scope_floor` of 4 against a stored counter of 5.** The counter has read **5** since the [D]→[C] breakthrough at `EVT-000588` — the count held at [D-Rank] Master immediately before it — and the prose still carried the pre-ascension floor. Section 7.4 is explicit that the prose line is a rendering of `current_value` and never an independent count. **Four further miners → five.** C-Rank Adept computes 4 on Section 7.4's authored *0 → 4 additional miners* ladder and the floor of 5 binds, so the reading that the rung bought the category rather than the count still holds — at one higher number.

  **5. Three surfaces still record `EVT-000590` as three breakthroughs into [S].** `170_CHANGELOG.md`, `180_CURRENT_STATE.md` and `system/ID_REGISTRY.md` each name **Keen Sense with `Across the seal`** and **Exploit Pattern with `Standing Pattern`** as granted. `EVT-000590` **withdrew both offers as unauthored and restored both skills to [A-Rank] Master**, and the character sheet and this chronicle have said so throughout. Three rolling views kept the pre-correction rendering through five checkpoints. All three corrected here.

  **The common cause, and it is not carelessness.** Every one of these five is a **rendered string with nothing to disagree with it.** A skill's Rank, mastery, uses, scenes and floors are `tracked_counters` under Decision 079 and cannot drift without a gate catching it; a *baseline*, a *subject count* and a *damage preview* are prose derived from them at write time, and a derivation done once by hand stays wrong until somebody redoes it by hand. Two of these were derived from the table's construction rather than read from the table — a shortcut that gives the right answer at every rung except the ones that matter, the ends. **`F-037`'s shape, three more instances.**

  **The corrections did not fit, and the budget was not raised to make them fit.** `/system gear` reads six fields of this sheet and stood at **19,010 tokens against a ratchet fail line of 19,047** before this Event — already on WARN, 37 tokens of headroom. Four correction notes added 125 and crossed it. **Three blocks of one-time history were displaced instead**, each already recorded in full in this chronicle and in `170_CHANGELOG.md`, and none of them current state that a loadout panel exists to show: Rupture's *the breakthrough paid +1,463 rather than costing anything*, Mana Bolt's *paid +149 rather than costing 21, the floor protects magnitude not cost*, and Flash Step's four-sentence ascension provenance, which ended by citing this chronicle anyway. **The surface closes at 18,988 — 22 tokens BELOW where it stood before the corrections**, and the correction rationale lives here, where a panel does not pay for it every time it is opened. `system/RUNTIME_CONTEXT_BUDGETS.yaml` is untouched: moving a warning because a number is inconvenient is an owner ruling, and this did not need one.

  **In fiction, nothing changed.** Rupture always hit as hard as Rupture hits. Alexander's read always reached the people it reached. The System never rendered these numbers to him at all."
```

## EVT-000596 - Quest Capacity: A Slot the System Rank Opened and Nobody Counted

```yaml
id: EVT-000596
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active
provenance:
  source: session-gameplay
  game_date: "2026-08-21 17:26 -05:00"

  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_formation
    result: none
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_credit
    result: none
description: "**Non-daily quest capacity stood at 5 against a System Rank of A, which the profile derives at 6.**

  Section 8.4.1 authors the ladder as **2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 at E / D / C / B / A / S**, derived from the Bearer's System Rank under Section 6.6 and from nothing else — *not granted by any skill, and no allocation, item, or title raises it.* **System Rank crossed B → A at `EVT-000589`** on the level 40 crossing, and every other consequence of that crossing settled in the same exchange: both Section 7.5 and Section 4.4 ceilings moved to S, the Section 3.2 growth rung went +23 → +63, a fourth title slot opened, and all five Stat Passives released and re-pinned. **`capacity_total` did not move, and it is derived from exactly the same value.**

  **Corrected: 5 → 6.** Nothing else changes. **Three quests are attached** — `warehouse-meridian-ownership` and two others — so the Bearer was never at his ceiling and no quest was refused, deferred or lost for want of the slot. What was wrong was the number, not an outcome it produced.

  **The failing gate found this, not a reading.** `tools/test_gatefall_quest_contract.ps1` derives the expected figure from the profile's ladder and the sheet's own `system_rank`, and has been red since the level 40 crossing: *Live non-daily capacity does not derive 6 from System Rank A.* It was correct and it was the only thing that noticed.

  **The same shape as `EVT-000595`, one field over.** A value the profile derives from another value, stored as a rendered number, with the derivation performed by hand at the moment the source moved — and the crossing at `EVT-000589` moved six things at once, of which five were re-derived and one was not. Section 6.6 calls System Rank *canonical derived state, read from level and never estimated*; the things read **from** it deserve the same treatment and do not have it.

  **Fixing it uncovered four more, because a failing suite stops at its first failure.** `test_gatefall_quest_contract.ps1` runs its assertions in order and throws on the first, so the capacity leg had been standing in front of everything after it since `EVT-000589`. Each of the four below was already broken, none of them was visible, and every one is a **rendering drifting away from the shape a contract reads** rather than a wrong value:

  **(a) All five Stat Passive rows broke Section 15.3.1's row contract.** `EVT-000591` wrote each skill's new S-Rank grant **between the Stat value and the next-threshold marker** — `Uses 89 · Perception 418 · **S-Rank grant: …** · [S-Rank] held: …` — which separates three fields the panel renders as one run, and crossed the bold markers while doing it. The grant now leads the row and the counters close it.

  **(b) The same five rows named a clamp that no longer binds.** They read *[S-Rank] held: System Rank ceiling*, which was true while System Rank B held them one rung below their derived Rank. **At System Rank A the ceiling is S and they hold S**, so nothing is holding them at all — the row renders the plain terminal **`S-Rank`**, the top of Section 4.4's ladder with no rung above it to promise.

  **(c) Flux Sight's tail was two Ranks stale on a line that already read [S-Rank].** It stated the skill *stands at A-Rank*, that the ceiling *rose with System Rank B*, and that S *needs* Perception 80 and System Rank A — conditions met at `EVT-000589` and named on the same line as unmet.

  **(d) Rupture's and Twin Fang's magnitude clauses were reworded out of contract shape.** Rupture rendered `**×2.60** of its S-Rank skill-rank baseline (938, §7.2)` where the contract reads `**×N of its skill-rank baseline** (<Rank>-Rank baseline <N>, Section 7.2)`; Twin Fang lost the words *Twin Fang mastery multiplier* at `EVT-000590`. **Neither value was wrong** — Rupture's baseline was separately wrong and is fixed at `EVT-000595` — but a gate that reads prose can only read the prose it was written against, and canon had quietly stopped speaking it.

  **The lesson is about the gate, not the sheet.** Three of these four sat behind one stale number for two days, and the suite reported one failure the whole time. A contract that aborts on first failure tells the truth about *a* defect and nothing about how many there are. **The suite now runs to completion and passes at 38 of 38.**

  **In fiction, nothing happened.** A capacity the Bearer has never reached rose by one. The System would have told him only if he had tried to hold a seventh thing at once."
```

## EVT-000597 - The Ability-Point Ledger Comes Under Decision 079

```yaml
id: EVT-000597
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active
provenance:
  source: session-gameplay
  game_date: "2026-08-21 17:26 -05:00"

  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_formation
    result: none
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_credit
    result: none
description: "**Profile 1.81 → 1.82 adopted, a required migration, and the baseline Event for six new `tracked_counters` paths.** No fictional time, no scene, no die. **No stored value moves** — every counter's baseline is what its value already is.

  **The reason is three Events old.** `EVT-000594` found twenty-five ability points allocated against a record of fifteen; `EVT-000595` found two skill baselines derived instead of read; `EVT-000596` found a quest capacity that never moved when the value it derives from did. **All three are the same defect** — a number kept as prose, with nothing able to disagree with it — and all three were found by reconciling state against the profile by hand, which is not a gate. Ability points were the last growth axis in this profile without one: XP and every skill counter had sat under Decision 079's `current_value = baseline_value + Σ(delta)` since 1.19 and 1.26.

  **Six paths, and their baselines are derived rather than asserted.** Each `allocated` total is `base_stat − creation_array[stat] − automatic(40)`, where the creation array 11 / 12 / 8 / 11 / 8 is held in `latent_stat_array` and `automatic(40) = 9×2 + 10×4 + 10×9 + 10×23 = 378` under Section 3.2's rung ladder:

  | Stat | Base | − creation | − automatic | **allocated** |
  |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
  | Strength | 441 | 11 | 378 | **52** |
  | Agility | 417 | 12 | 378 | **27** |
  | Vitality | 499 | 8 | 378 | **113** |
  | Perception | 418 | 11 | 378 | **29** |
  | Intelligence | 488 | 8 | 378 | **102** |

  **`progression.ability_points_earned` baselines at 323**, taken from the pool identity `Σ allocated + unspent_points` = 323 + 0 rather than re-totalled from level-ups, dailies and title payments. **That choice is deliberate and its reason is recorded**: the level-up and Title Assessment lines are exact, but the daily Ability Point line lands **within one point** of closing depending on the unresolved ruling about which daily first paid an Ascetic-boosted +4. Allocated and unspent are hard state, so the identity fixes earned at 323 whichever way that ruling goes. **Gating does not settle the attribution and does not pretend to.**

  **Two values stop being stored.** `unspent_points` is now a rendering of `earned − Σ allocated`. **A base Stat is a rendering of `creation + automatic(level) + allocated`** — the five integers in `stats:` are what that formula returns, not an independent record of it.

  **The whole check is one line, and it works because Section 3.2 is uniform.** Every level crossing raises *all five* base Stats by the same rung, so `base − creation − allocated` must be **the same integer for all five**. Today that integer is **378**, five times over. **Had `EVT-000594`'s ten Intelligence points gone undeclared, Intelligence would read 368 against four Stats reading 378** — a failing gate at the settlement rather than an audit finding three days later.

  **What is guaranteed starts now.** Baselines are prospective: no historical Event gains `counter_deltas`, no past allocation is revisited, and nothing the ledger could not previously prove about its own past becomes provable. From this Event forward a level-up writes +5 to `ability_points_earned`, a daily reward and a grade payment write theirs, an allocation writes its points to the named Stat — and **a settlement that moves a base Stat without a matching delta fails validation.**

  **Two things this does not close, said plainly.** The Ascetic claim-timing question is untouched and still open. And `titles.points_granted` disagreeing with the sum of its own `earned_names` grade payments — the `EVT-000594` half that was a title-ledger field rather than a pool — is a real defect of this class that these counters do not reach.

  **In fiction, nothing whatever happened.** The System has never shown Alexander a counter. It has only ever shown him a number, and the number has not changed."
```

## EVT-000598 - The Ascetic Sentence Is Struck, and the Ability-Point History Closes

```yaml

    domain: gatefall.skill_formation
    result: none
  - subject: ENT-000125

    result: none
description: "**Owner ruling. One sentence struck from `skill_rulings.ascetic_claim_timing_evt_000357`, and the campaign's ability-point history closes with it.** No fictional time, no scene, no die, **no stored value moves**, and the profile is untouched — Sections 8.1 and 16.2 already say the right thing.

  **The rule was never ambiguous.** The daily Ability Points reward is **+3 by default and +4 while Ascetic is equipped**, read from canonical state **at the moment the entry is claimed** rather than when it was issued. `EVT-000522` ruled that, and settled `EVT-000357`'s own entry at the issued +3 because the declared order was claim-then-equip.

  **The sentence that closed that ruling was.** It read *from the twenty-second daily onward the +4 applies unambiguously and this ruling does not reach it* — a blanket claim about every later daily, written when the equip history looked simpler than it was. **The equip record contradicts it.** Ascetic sat in the `EVT-000357` loadout; it was swapped out when the loadout became Cartographer + Untouchable, a change this sheet did not carry until the `EVT-000444` correction; and it was only restored at `EVT-000535` on 2026-08-19, which is what made the twenty-seventh daily read +4. **There was no continuous run from the twenty-second, so nothing about that stretch is unambiguous and the sentence was asserting otherwise.**

  **Struck. What governs is the rule the same ruling states**: +4 where Ascetic was equipped at claim, +3 where it was not, read off the equip record rather than off a date.

  **The arithmetic settles which reading is right, rather than the other way round.** The pool is fixed by hard state — `Σ allocated + unspent` = **323** — and two of its three sources are exact: **195** from thirty-nine level crossings at +5, and **40** from thirteen title grade payments, now gated at `EVT-000597`. The daily line is therefore **88**, which is twenty-eight dailies at +3 plus **exactly four** that paid +4.

  | Source | Points |
  |---|---:|
  | Level-ups, 39 crossings × 5 | 195 |
  | Title grade payments, 13 titles | 40 |
  | Daily Ability Point rewards, 28 dailies (24 at +3, 4 at +4) | 88 |
  | **Earned** | **323** |
  | Allocated | 323 |
  | Unspent | 0 |

  **The struck sentence produced 91 and could not close.** Seven dailies at +4 from the twenty-second onward overshoots the pool by three, and three points that were earned and never allocated would have to exist somewhere. **They do not.** Four +4 dailies is also what the record already shows: `EVT-000487` names *the +8 from two claimed AP entries*, two +4 dailies while Ascetic sat in the early loadout, and the twenty-seventh paid +4 after `EVT-000535`.

  **The exact four are not enumerated here, deliberately.** Naming which dailies paid what would be reconstructing per-entry history from prose, which is the thing Profile 1.82's migration declines to do and for the same reason: the ledger cannot prove it, and a confident list would be an assertion dressed as a record. **What is proved is the total**, and the total is what the counter holds.

  **This closes the ability-point ledger.** `EVT-000594` found the ten undeclared Intelligence points, `EVT-000597` put the axis under Decision 079 and gated it forward, and this closes the one question the counters could not answer about the past. **Nothing further is owed on it.**

  **In fiction, nothing happened.** Alexander has claimed twenty-eight daily rewards and has never once been shown a running total of them."
```

## EVT-000601 - Profile Adoption: Gatefall 1.82 -> 1.83, and a Mastery Level That Returns Something

```yaml
id: EVT-000601
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active
provenance:
  source: session-gameplay
  game_date: "2026-08-21 17:26 -05:00"
  real_date: "2026-08-18"
type: Event
kind: profile-adoption
importance: pivotal
game_date: "2026-08-21 17:26 -05:00"
participants: []
counter_deltas:
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.silent_step.scope_floor, delta: 5 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.broken_rhythm.scope_floor, delta: 3 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.field_command.scope_floor, delta: 3 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.rupture.magnitude_floor, delta: 30 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.mana_bolt.magnitude_floor, delta: 15 }
progression_audits:
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_formation
    result: none
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_credit
    result: none
description: "**Profile 1.82 -> 1.83 adopted, a required migration.** No fictional time, no scene, no die. Migration record `worlds/gatefall/migrations/1.82_to_1.83.md`.

  **A mastery level costs three qualifying scenes, and nine of sixteen skills were charging that and returning nothing.** Section 7.4 has been amended for this twice already — `F-014` when Broken Rhythm had no axis at all, and 1.52 when the axis table was added so no skill's levelling would be undocumented again. **Both fixes gave every skill an axis and neither asked whether the axis could pay.**

  **Three routes to nothing, measured rather than supposed.** A **magnitude pinned by its own floor**: a Rank-baseline skill's multiplier band is identical at every Rank, so `magnitude_floor` lands equal to the new Rank's *Master* value and every level up to Master authors a number already in force — Rupture at [S] Adept authoring ×2.30 under a floor of ×2.60. A **duration already saturated** one Rank above native, which is Sprint and Flash Step. And **a count of other people** — five skills whose mastery axis counted allies, beneficiaries, recipients or miners, in which a Bearer who clears content alone held **twenty-two slots and filled none**, at three qualifying scenes each.

  **The rule: a mastery level must return something to the Bearer, in the play he is actually in.** Four clauses. A binding floor **ratchets** with mastery. A saturated duration pays elsewhere, applied consistently. A **shared count moves to Rank** — `+0/+1/+2/+3/+4` and **double at S-Rank** — so the level buys a five-rung self-facing **dividend** instead. Anything left pays Mana.

  **Nothing is deleted and nobody loses reach.** Sharing survives everywhere it exists; it stops costing a mastery level. **Field Command becomes the profile's one sharing skill** and gains `Conduction`, which extends his own sustained effects to allies who could not otherwise receive them. Stone Skin, Bulwark, Twin Fang, Dagger Mastery, Mend, Exploit Pattern and Dimensional Projection keep every category and every axis they had, including every one that shares.

  **Seven dividends authored, five rungs each, none longer than another**: `Resolution` (Keen Sense), `Composure` (Silent Step), `Tempo` (Broken Rhythm), `Yield` (Resonance Extraction), `Control` (Sprint), `Arrival` (Flash Step), `Conduction` (Field Command). They obey the division of labour the Rank ladders already follow — **Rank sells what a skill can reach; mastery sells how well it resolves** — and every rung was checked against that skill's own six Rank categories, because the first draft of them re-sold four rungs the skills already held.

  **`Tempo` is the reaction economy, and nothing else in this profile governs it.** Reactions appear throughout — Bulwark's `Anticipated`, Twin Fang's `Answer`, Micro-rift deflection by definition — and no skill has ever said how many a Bearer gets. Cadence is the beat of an exchange rather than perception or armour, so the economy is Broken Rhythm's ground; it compounds with the defensive kit instead of duplicating it, and it pays hardest exactly where a solo Bearer suffers most.

  **Exploit Pattern is excluded and unchanged.** Its count is *concurrent Patterns* — his own reads, not people — and it already pays him in full alone.

  **Section 7.2 states retention once instead of three times**: *nothing a skill has earned is ever taken back* — a category earned by Rank, a dividend rung earned by mastery, a scope count and a magnitude, all permanent through every ascension on either road. The scope and magnitude ratchets become consequences of that rule rather than separate patches, and `dividend_level` is monotonic and given no floor because a dividend cannot fall.

  **Broken Rhythm's `Cold read` and `Shared cadence` are ratified** under Section 7.1. This campaign has rendered them since its rune ascension while the profile authored *Unseen cadence* and *Read the room* — two pairs, neither aware of the other, with the Bearer holding the pair nobody wrote down. **Ratified as a choice rather than by survival**: `EVT-000590` withdrew improvised rungs of exactly this class three days earlier, and the difference is that this one was decided. Nothing he holds is withdrawn.

  **Every dead level is repaid, capped at five rungs, overflow to Mana.** Thirty levels across nine skills, reconstructed from the checkpoint history:

  | Skill | Dead | Lands at |
  |---|---:|---|
  | Keen Sense | 9 | `Resolution` **5/5**, Mana 2 -> **1**, three levels past the floor returning nothing |
  | Silent Step | 5 | `Composure` **5/5** |
  | Flash Step | 4 | `Arrival` 4/5 |
  | Resonance Extraction | 4 | `Yield` 4/5 |
  | Rupture | 2 | `magnitude_floor` ×2.60 -> **×2.90**, DMG 3,877 -> **4,324** |
  | Broken Rhythm | 2 | `Tempo` 2/5 |
  | Field Command | 2 | `Conduction` 2/5 |
  | Mana Bolt | 1 | `magnitude_floor` ×1.60 -> **×1.75**, DMG 1,026 -> **1,122** |
  | Sprint | 1 | `Control` 1/5 |

  **Three floors are set so clause 3 takes nothing**: Silent Step `scope_floor` 0 -> 5, Broken Rhythm 0 -> 3, Field Command 0 -> 3. Keen Sense and Resonance Extraction already held theirs.

  **Flash Step's follow-up window is corrected to whole scene.** Section 7.2 saturates duration at one Rank above native and this skill has stood three Ranks above native since C-Rank; the line had never rendered it. A rendering correction, not a grant.

  **Keen Sense finishes, and it is recorded so it is not later mistaken for a defect.** Its dividend maxes, its Mana floors at 1, and it already stands at the Section 7.5 ceiling — so it holds no growth on any axis until System Rank S at level 50. That is the correct outcome for 85 successful uses and 57 qualifying scenes: the campaign's most-exercised skill is complete.

  **In fiction, nothing announced itself.** The System does not narrate its own corrections. What changed is that the next three scenes Alexander spends on a skill will leave a mark on it, which has not reliably been true for nine of them."
```

Two that had been written out had drifted to 77 and nothing caught them, because 27 right and 2 wrong are indistinguishable when the other 136 are ellipses. No rendered window changed.

One fusion per piece, permanently. Cost is the donor plus one core at the result's Rank or four below, the Section 12.8 fee anchor, and bench days that are never same-day. **The magnitude clause is the design**: worn reduction stands at 46.2% against a Combat Tier S threshold of about 60%, and a rule letting two pieces pool protection into one slot would have dissolved that threshold without a Rank being climbed.

  **1.85 -> 1.86 - Seamwork.** Section 12.8's *there is no player crafting subsystem* was read as barring the Bearer from artificer work entirely, and `EVT-000485`'s batch settlement closed the infusion formation candidate as `none` on that reading - **citing no owner ruling** - then added that it was recorded so a later session would not re-litigate it. **The owner reopened it**, on the profile's own Section 13.6: the Bearer is *the sole exception* to one-signature-for-life, and *learned Mend grants its heal but not the full innate-mender package* is the same rule the other rare trade already had. **Seamwork** is authored at Section 7.3, native C-Rank, Mana 3, four rungs - Read and open / Seat / Lift / Raise - under one boundary: **it never creates an item**, and matter carrying no mana line is inert to it. Improvement is licensed; origination is not. Three bounds hold the economy and none is new - an item's authored ceiling, material spent at the Section 12.8 anchor, and his own Seamwork Rank.

  **Nothing in fiction announced any of it.** The System does not narrate its own corrections, and two of the three edges are invisible from inside the world entirely."

## EVT-000603 - The Bench, and the Question the Profile Could Not Answer

```yaml
id: EVT-000603
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active
provenance:
  source: session-gameplay
  game_date: "2026-08-21 21:20 -05:00"
  real_date: "2026-08-19"
type: Event
kind: scene
importance: major
game_date: "2026-08-21 21:20 -05:00"
participants:
  - ENT-000125
  - ENT-000203
counter_deltas: []
progression_audits:
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_credit
    result: none
participation_audits:
  - subject: ENT-000125
    result: record-updated
    record: ENT-000125
  - subject: ENT-000203
    result: record-updated
    record: REL-000096
description: "**2026-08-21, 17:30 to 21:20. The Rogers Park apartment, then Priscilla Nakamura's workshop.** No danger, no combat, no Mana spent, and one resolved die.

  **The apartment, and a shelf nobody had established.** He read for a while before leaving - a physics or mathematics text from his own degree, margins already crowded in his own hand from a year when he still thought that was the whole plan. **Established this Event: the flat carries a real personal library**, coursework and papers, which a recent graduate in mathematics and physics obviously owns and which no prior Event had needed to say. Twenty minutes in he had stopped reading and started drawing something in the margin that was closer to a rift anchor than a field line, and noticed himself doing it.

  **A Flux Sight sweep that returned nothing, recorded because the null result is the point.** He read the four boss materials he is carrying - the drowned mana nodule, the bone-lattice plating, both lots of alpha-strain sinew. All four returned exactly what `EVT-000592`'s Ceiling Register already holds: catalogued component material whose ceiling is defined by what it is made into. **No counter moves.** The register is a property of each object and does not expire, so a re-read of unchanged holdings is trivial repetition rather than a material application, and is recorded as an explicit nil rather than left to inference.

  **19:20, ten minutes early, and she opened the door before the second knock, as she always does.**

  **He asked her to fuse the two Warded Vambraces, and produced them from a backpack he does not need.** The request was the first time anyone in this campaign has asked for an operation the World Rule Profile did not author. **She did not pretend to know.** Her answer named the shape of her own uncertainty rather than quoting a price around it: she has built from nothing with a client watching and has never had two finished pieces on a bench and been asked to make them stop being two pieces. *'That's not a no. That's - I don't actually know what that costs me, or what comes out the other side. I'm not going to guess at you and call it a quote.'* She would not touch his gear until she knew what she was risking on it.

  **He bought two E-Rank Hunter's Bands to practise on, 80 g each, and she refused them for a reason he had not considered.** Not that they were cheap - that there is **nothing in them to move.** A catalogue accessory assigns its whole budget to one stat and carries no second passive (Section 11.5), so it is a number in a shape and can never be a fusion donor at any Rank. *'Somebody decided a hit should land softer and then made the metal agree with them. That's what I'd be moving - the decision, not the number.'* She noted without asking that two brand-new pieces with no maker's mark and no licensed provenance had arrived on her bench, and said nothing about it, which is the discretion Wade Bishop characterised as a condition rather than a guarantee.

  **The practical, and the half of fusion that can be practised on worthless stock.** She corrected his framing twice before handing him a tool: fusion is not joining, it is two jobs, and the first one kills gear. Making is what he has done since Tuesday - put mana in, hold it, let it set. **Fusion runs the other way first: a working has to come OUT intact before it can go anywhere, and the coming-out is where everything dies.** The bands cannot donate and still cannot; they can be **opened**, and opening is the expensive half.

  **He opened one. Roll d100 49, +1 demonstrated infusion capability graded at `EVT-000550`, +1 direct instruction at her own bench with her own tools, -1 unmaking inverts everything he has ever practised; net +1, effective 69, success.** It went wrong for about ninety seconds in the way she said it always goes wrong for makers - he kept reaching for the pressure that seats a crystal, and the working read that as *more* and closed harder against him. Her instruction was four words: *stop pushing, start listening.* The fourth attempt opened it. Not far, and not usefully - there is nothing inside an E-Rank stat line worth having - but open, and the metal undamaged.

  **'That took me eleven months.'** Said flat, with no warmth, which from her is not small. She wrote a line in the ledger rather than a figure, then refused the reading he might have taken from it: *'You opened the simplest object the trade makes, on a bench, with no clock and me standing here. A vambrace is not that, and I still haven't done one.'*

  **She booked Wednesday for her own reasons.** Bring the vambraces, touch nothing: she wants to see what a working that has **reached its ceiling** does under a read, before there is fifty thousand dollars of one in pieces on her bench. That is the second time in a week she has set a piece of this programme as a fact rather than a proposal.

  **Health settles to full across the span** - 1,980 to 2,000 over three hours fifty at rest (Section 6.1.1), remainder zeroed at cap. Mana was already full and no skill was cast. **Gold 367,501 -> 367,341.** The second band is untouched; the first is open, intact, and mechanically unchanged at Strength +1."
```

description: "**Batch settlement for the structured-practice note sealed at `EVT-000603`, and the ratification it reached.** Section 7.1 defers non-combat classification to the promotion barrier; this is that barrier, and it produces the settlement rather than discarding it.

  **`gatefall.skill_credit` is `none`**: the span contains no dangerous scene. No combat skill activated, no material passive applied beyond the nil Flux Sight read recorded at `EVT-000603`, and no Mana was spent at any point between 17:30 and 21:20.

  **`gatefall.skill_formation` ratifies SEAMWORK, automatically and without an adjudication queue.** Profile 1.86 authors the candidate's complete name, Rank, Mana cost, effect, limits and mastery progression, and Section 7.1 requires that such a candidate ratify in this same settlement rather than pause in `pending-ratification`.

  **The evidence, three distinct qualifying scenes under Section 7.1's five tests.** `EVT-000485` - three crystal-seating attempts on a disposable torso under Nakamura's instruction, a critical fumble that cost him a real burn on two fingers, then two clean seatings, the second fast enough she called it apprentice-grade. `EVT-000550` - a full stat-building infusion, exceptional success, a ninety-second hold, one C-Rank Mana Crystal consumed and **woven rather than merely seated**, a result she has personally produced twice in her career. `EVT-000603` - a finished working opened intact, against resistance, on a fourth attempt after three that closed against him. Each is a separate structured practice session with a declared objective, uncertain execution, real feedback, and material success.

  **This candidate was closed once, and the closure is superseded rather than erased.** `EVT-000485`'s batch settlement classified it `none` on the reading that Section 12.8's *there is no player crafting subsystem* barred the Bearer from artificer work of any kind, **citing no owner ruling**, and added that it was recorded so a later session would not re-litigate it. Section 7.1 reopens a closed candidate **only by owner ruling**, and the owner has given one: Section 13.6 makes the Bearer *the sole exception* to one-signature-for-life, and already authors *learned Mend grants its heal but not the full innate-mender package* for the parallel trade. `EVT-000485` stands as the record of what was decided and by whom; the engine-side defect - a Runtime audit reaching ruling authority by assertion and sealing itself against review - is recorded as `F-039`.

  **SEAMWORK [C-Rank] Novice, Mana 3.** Native **C** rather than E, because Section 7.1 puts Rank among the things ratification authors and Section 18.3.1 forbids a grant returning nothing the Bearer already lacks: the evidence shows him reading another maker's mid-process corrections unprompted and opening a finished working intact, so an E-Rank entry rung reading *detect that a working is present* would have authored **two Ranks of nothing** beneath the record that earned it.

  **Counters initialise at zero with this Event as baseline** - `successful_uses` 0, `qualifying_scenes_total` 0, `mastery_progress` 0/3, `mastery_level` 1, `rank_ascensions` 0. Section 7.1: pre-ratification evidence establishes acquisition only and never backfills. **The asymmetry is deliberate on Rank and unexplained on mastery**, and is raised as `F-040` rather than resolved here: a technique whose Rank may be authored from its evidence, but whose mastery track may not, starts identical to one that scraped three bare passes.

  **What it grants, and the boundary that is the whole of it.** Read and open at C; Seat at B; Lift at A; Raise at S. It **never creates an item** and matter carrying no mana line is inert to it. It never raises a piece past its authored ceiling, always spends material, and is gated by its own Rank. He is not a licensed artificer: no standing, no commissions, and **Section 12.10's fusion still resolves on the artificer performing it** - assisting is not performing. Mastery sells `Hand`, the cost of being wrong: at Novice a failed working spends its material and closes the piece to him for the scene.

  **Section 12.10's assist step is live from this Event**, because it requires Seamwork at C-Rank or above and C-Rank is where he entered.

  **In fiction, one Tier-1 window fired at her bench and nobody else saw it.** The first technique this System has ever granted him that neither strikes, moves, hides nor perceives - it **reads**. A physicist who took a hunting licence because capability is the price of access has just been handed an instrument, and the woman two feet away saw a man go absent for two seconds and wrote a line in her ledger."
```

  **Population, real dice: 6 commons, 1 elite, 1 boss, all D-Rank.** Formation execution resolved in two aggregate checks per the established crew doctrine (three elements under Grant/Corbin/Owen, Iris on overwatch): commons+elite phase 🎲 d100 93, strong; boss encounter 🎲 d100 97, exceptional — Iris's own read opened the boss a full beat early, killing strike landed before its signature could fire. Zero injuries worse than a scrape. Alexander called three formation adjustments and took no strike role; his one live-die contribution was a successful Exploit Pattern read (🎲 d100 25, effective via established-capability step) relayed through Field Command to Corbin's element, materially contributing to the elite's kill.

  **Loot: 6 D-Rank crystals (commons), 1 D-Rank crystal + 1 D-Rank core (elite), 1 D-Rank core (boss); mined deposit 3d6=6 → 12 base ×2 (D-Rank) → +20% (Resonance Extraction, owner-ruled this span) → 14.4→14 → +2 (Prospector) = **16**. Total 28 D-Rank crystals, 2 D-Rank cores. Boss drop 🎲 d100 39 → equipment, d20 18 → **Seer's Lens [D-Rank]**, Boss Imprint (Predator: +1 Agility; Mobility Echo), d6 4 → Crystalline finish.

  **Split under standard Coalition terms (§13.2): 10% leader's share, remainder equal among all ten.** Pool valued at licensed rates: crystals $16,800 + cores $3,000 + the Lens sold back into the pool via Alexander's own $3,000 buy-in (he kept the item) = $22,800. Leader's share $2,280 + equal share $2,052 = **$4,332 to Alexander**; net **+$1,332** after his buy-in. $2,052 each to the other nine.

  **Alexander's XP: 200** — the relay-fed elite kill (D-Rank ×2 = 50) and the D-Rank Gate-clear milestone (150), seated on that relay making him a materially contributing party member under §3.8. No underdog multiplier (D-Rank sits below System Rank A).

  **Four rings to voicemail**, which is not what Dale's phone does - he has answered on two or texted inside ten minutes every time since July. No message left. At 14:09 a reply landed reading in full *'can't. 1900 still good'* - three words and a number, with none of the ornamentation he puts on even a two-sentence text.

  **Disposition authored under Decision 092 before his first line.** His record predates the campaign's `disposition_baseline: ENT-000210`, so `want`, `fear`, `secret`, `voice`, `beliefs` and `agenda` were written into `130_NPCS_AND_FACTIONS.md` from established canon in the same response - the want being eight combat-rated bodies before the client stops waiting, and the secret being that the bigger client has let him understand the eight-body requirement is about the filing rather than the site, six days unanswered. He has no idea he is describing the class of filing Alexander holds unfiled (`OBJ-27`).

  No canon contradicted. Alexander's position unchanged - still on the route from Walt Adamik's shop."

  **Fifteen minutes to answer four sentences**, then *'No problem at all.'* Dale Pruitt does not write *at all*; the politeness is the flattening his record names as his tell, the half-smile going watchful with nothing else changed.   **And then nothing.** No next week, no say when, no dry line about calendars. A man who, asked sixteen days ago when and where, produced a night, a window, a street and a reason for the street, was handed the obvious opening to name another and did not take it. **The beer owed since the Frozen Gallery stays owed.**

  `OBJ-33` moves from **open, scheduled** to **open, unscheduled - cancelled by Alexander, no replacement offered.** Recorded as a characterization promotion on `ENT-000135` under Decision 076: **the first time Dale has let an arrangement of his own making drop without producing an alternative.** What he intended to ask over it - what Alexander is actually doing with himself - went unasked, and the venue he chose because nobody in the trade drinks there went unused."

  **Sixty D-Rank bodies, all combat resolved automatically under Rules Section 4.2** - failure impossible at 930 main-hand damage against a 100-Health common, Combat Tier A against D. **No damage taken across the whole run**, no Mana spent (weapon kills; Resonance Extraction is passive).

  **Take: 186 D-Rank crystals, 13 D-Rank cores, five boss drops. XP 2,900.**

  **LEVEL 40 -> 41, settled inside instance 4** where XP crossed 4,000 (Section 3.2, System Rank A rung): **+63 to all five base Stats**, +5 unspent points, maxima re-derived, pools restored. Base 441/417/499/418/488 -> **504/480/562/481/551**; effective 455/461/500/423/495 -> **518/524/563/486/558** on unchanged equipment lines. **Maximum Health 2,000 -> 2,252; maximum Mana 990 -> 1,116.** XP 797/4,100. No Title Assessment - 41 is not a decade level. Instance 5 ran at the new figures.

Mend unchanged - healing does not read Intelligence. **The Twin Fang package and the projected Quickknife are composites that could not be confirmed against the loaded formula and were deliberately not asserted; re-derivation is owed before anything reads them.**

  **The Section 19.2 S-Rank licence gap falls from 243 to 109 maximum Mana** - inside one further level at the +63 rung. Combat Tier S's Health gap falls from 700 to 448.

  **Section 7.4 settlement, stated because it is the span's one contestable call.** `successful_uses` credited in full - Dagger Mastery +60 (a passive counts once per resolved action in which it materially applies), Resonance Extraction +5 (five deliberate vein reads, each successful). **`qualifying_scenes_total` credited ZERO for both, and mastery progress does not move.** Section 7.4 requires genuine dangerous-scene contribution for a combat skill, requires uncertainty or informative resistance for a non-combat one, and holds that *trivial repetition does not count* and *the three scenes must be materially distinct*. Sixty automatic-resolution kills three Ranks below the Bearer, taking no damage, across five near-identical instances, is the paradigm case the rule describes. **This is the first live application of the qualifying-scene distinctness question since `EVT-000574` closed its retroactivity forward-only, and the owner ruling authoring that test into Section 7.4 is still outstanding.**"

## EVT-000617 - Owner Ruling: Sub-Rank Clear Time Runs on a Halving Ladder

```yaml
id: EVT-000617
canonical_record: REC-000079

status: active

  source: owner-ruling

  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_formation
    result: none
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_credit
    result: none
description: "**Raised because the Runtime invented a duration.** Section 17 authors a two-hour instance cap and a voluntary exit at any time; it authors no clearing time at all. The Runtime nonetheless narrated the first instance as taking an hour and five minutes, and a fifteen-minute walk home before it, neither read from any rule. The player caught both.

  **The ruling, binding from this Event.** Time to fully clear *and* loot an instance halves for each Rank the content stands below the Bearer:

  - at Rank or above - Section 17's full two-hour window, unchanged;
  - **1 Rank below - 60 minutes**; **2 below - 30**; **3 below - 15**; 4 below - 7.5; 5 below - ~4. **No floor**; the halving continues.

  **The differential reads from Combat Tier (Section 6.7), not System Rank (Section 6.6)** - the profile's own measure of how hard content is for him, already what sizes the class trial at entry. Both read A today; they diverge as Combat Tier S approaches ahead of level 50.

  Applied to this span: **D-Rank against Combat Tier A is three steps down -> 15 minutes**, killing and mining both. The five instances therefore ran 14:45-16:00 rather than the narrated 15:00-16:20, and the Ashfield archetype's hourly burn check could not fire in instance 3.

  **A second gap was named and deliberately left unruled: Section 17 does not author what an onlooker sees when the Bearer opens an instance in public.** It states the instance is invisible to the authorities because only his key opens it and only he perceives the System, which is a fact about the space rather than about whether his body leaves the sidewalk. Every prior instant dungeon this campaign has run was opened somewhere private. This span opened five in seventy-five minutes on a Chicago street in daylight. **No consequence was applied and none was invented.**

  **Both go to the world-side authoring backlog against a frozen Profile 1.86.** A third gap surfaced at `EVT-000618`: Section 12.5 prices runes and keys for resale but never skill books."
```

## EVT-000620 - Owner Ruling: What a Bystander Sees, and the Discipline That Means It Never Comes Up

```yaml
id: EVT-000620
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active

  source: owner-ruling

participants:
  - ENT-000125
counter_deltas: []
progression_audits:
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_formation
    result: none
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_credit
    result: none
description: "**Closes the gap raised and deliberately left unruled at `EVT-000617`.** Section 17 states an instant dungeon is invisible to the authorities because only the Bearer's key opens it and only he perceives the System — a fact about the *space*, not about whether his body leaves the street.

  **The ruling, in two parts.**

  1. **Opening is physically visible. A bystander sees him disappear**, and sees him reappear when the instance closes. The System is imperceptible; the vacancy is not. Nothing about Section 14.4's Bearer-only perception conceals the fact that a man was standing there and now is not.
  2. **He never opens one where he can be seen.** This is the protagonist's own standing discipline, authored by the player, and it is why part 1 has never produced a consequence in ninety days of play.

  **Applied retroactively to this span, as a clarification rather than a change.** The five instances of `EVT-000616` were opened out of sight — the Runtime had narrated them as opened *from wherever the walk had reached*, which was itself a correction of an earlier unauthored walk home, and neither narration ever established a witness. **No consequence is created and none is removed.** The record now says what he actually does instead of leaving it unstated.

  **What this leaves live.** The discipline is a choice, and a choice can be forced: an emergency opening under observation, a sealed room with a camera in it, or a companion standing next to him remain open questions the fiction can ask. **Part 1 is what makes them cost something.** Removed from the world-side authoring backlog, which returns to **eight** — `EVT-000617`'s clear-time ladder and `EVT-000618`'s skill-book resale pricing being the two this session added, against the six it inherited."
```

## EVT-000625 - Owner Ruling: A Qualifying Scene Is a Live Resolution, Not a Dangerous One

```yaml
id: EVT-000625
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active
provenance:
  source: owner-ruling
  game_date: "2026-08-22 16:30 -05:00"
  real_date: "2026-08-20"
type: Event
kind: ruling
importance: major
game_date: "2026-08-22 16:30 -05:00"
participants:
  - ENT-000125
counter_deltas: []
progression_audits:
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_formation
    result: none
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_credit
    result: none
description: "**Settles the Section 7.4 qualifying-scene question that has sat on the authoring backlog since `EVT-000574` closed its retroactivity forward-only**, and that `EVT-000616` applied by judgment rather than by rule.

  **The ruling:** a scene credits a qualifying scene **where the resolution could actually fail.** Where Rules Section 4.2 automatic resolution disposes of every foe — nothing can miss, nothing survives a standard hit — no qualifying scene is credited. Where any foe requires a real die, the scene qualifies.

  **The test is live resolution, not danger.** That was the contested half. The evidence put both readings on the table: instance 1 cost him **42 Health of a 2,252 pool — 1.9%**, which is not danger by any reading; and it also contained a **natural fumble that cost a real exchange** and a boss that **survived a standard hit and answered**, which automatic resolution cannot produce. The owner ruled that exercising a skill against an outcome that can go wrong is what a mastery track is measuring, and that a pool the Bearer never notices is not.

  **What it settles, mechanically.** D-Rank at three steps below Combat Tier credits nothing — `EVT-000616`'s zero stands unchanged, now on a rule rather than a judgment. **C-Rank at two steps below credits**, because the boss survives a standard hit. The line moves with him rather than sitting at a fixed Rank differential, and it is checkable from the resolution itself.

  **What it costs him.** Mastery is now purchasable — three C-Rank keys are 30,000 g and yield three qualifying scenes — but only up to the point where his own growth makes C-Rank automatic too. **The advancement wall did not disappear; it acquired a price and a shelf life.**

  Added to the world-side authoring backlog against a frozen Profile 1.86, which stands at **nine**."
```

  **The `EVT-000626` player-choice drop resolved: a second Quickknife [C-Rank].** Its imprint is fixed from the boss under Section 11.2.1 rather than rolled, so the Flooded Mine boss is authored here from the fight as it resolved — **Serpentine** body family (coiling, swimming, many-jointed), **Control** signature (it went for a hold in the standing water and missed on a 🎲 36).   **Only one Boss-Imprint Echo may be invoked per scene** regardless of how many imprinted pieces are worn, and he now carries five. **For a man who enters sealed instances alone, *break a restraint* is not a throwaway.**

  **A Runtime error corrected in the same exchange.** The Runtime had twice stated that Section 12.10 fusion requires **identical** pieces, inferring it from the authored Warded Vambrace example. The Ghost Quickknife [A-Rank] is two Ranks off and cannot be bridged. Nothing is committed; Nakamura's bench is at 19:30 and she has never completed a fusion."

  **A third drift, older than this span, closed in passing.** `pending_rewards.ability_points` still read **4** after `EVT-000623` claimed and spent that entry at 16:00 — a stored value with no counter to disagree with it, the `F-015` shape.   **Rosalind Fenn (`ENT-000198`) delivered by text rather than by call**, consistent with her own established rule about what she is willing to put in writing.

  **The finding.** The Region V office is **not owned by anyone with their name on a door.** It runs **three shells deep**, and it is **the same shape as the shell behind Marnie's storage unit** — different registered agent, identical architecture. **She cannot get past the third layer from where she sits**, and she is explicit about why: whoever built it knew exactly how far a licensed private investigator's tools reach and **stopped one shell short of that on purpose.**

I don't think that's a coincidence and I'm not going to pretend I do.'* This is the second time she has hit a deliberately-bounded shell on a thread of Alexander's, and the first time she has named the pattern across both instead of reporting each finding in isolation.

  **Channel check.** Both halves are hers by direct work: she established the Marnie storage-unit shell herself at `EVT-000490`, and the Ironline ownership question is the brief Alexander gave her. She holds no channel to the System and nothing here touches the Bearer-Only Register.

  **She refused payment.** *'Not billing you for tonight. This one I wanted to know myself.'* **Recorded as a characterization promotion under Decision 076 — a break from an established pattern.** Her `want` on record is to be paid on results and to keep the Walt Adamik referral channel clean; a PI who bills on results lives on the next recommendation, and working a night unbilled because the question interests her is the first time she has done anything of the kind. It is not generosity toward Alexander; it is her own curiosity outrunning her invoice.

  **What it does to the board.** `OBJ-27` and `OBJ-36` stop being adjacent and start being **the same architecture seen from two ends**. The fenced warehouse's three-layer shell, Marnie's storage unit, and now the Region V office all resolve into structures built by someone who knows precisely where a licensed investigator's reach stops. **Nothing confirms one operation behind all three** — that inference is available and unmade. What is established is the shape, the deliberateness, and that a professional hit the same wall twice.

  No pools, counters, gold or cash move. Alexander is on the street outside the workshop with a live thread in his hand and nothing he is obliged to answer tonight."

## EVT-000654 - Profile 1.87 Adopted: An Attacker May Choose Not To Kill

```yaml
id: EVT-000654
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active
provenance:
  source: session-gameplay
  game_date: "2026-08-22 23:55 -05:00"
  real_date: "2026-08-21"
type: Event
kind: migration
importance: major
game_date: "2026-08-22 23:55 -05:00"
participants:
  - ENT-000125
counter_deltas: []
progression_audits:
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_formation
    result: none
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_credit
    result: none
participation_audits:
  - subject: ENT-000125
    result: record-updated
    record: REC-000074
description: "**Gatefall World Rule Profile 1.86 -> 1.87 adopted at the campaign's current anchor.** The world side landed as an engine change; this Event is the campaign record it deliberately left owed, because minting identifiers and writing canon is play rather than authoring.

  **The defect.** Section 6.2 resolved every landed hit into a damage figure and removed it from Health; Section 6.3 converted heavy results into injuries; Section 6.5 made death final. **Nothing anywhere authored an attacker doing less than his magnitude on purpose** - a grep of the whole profile for `subdue`, `non-lethal`, `unconscious` and `knock out` returned nothing. Sections 4.0 and 4.1 have always established that intent precedes method and that the die resolves a *declared* action, so *I am pulling this* was a legitimate declaration under sections in force that evaporated between declaring and resolving. **The hole was in the resolution surface, not in the permission.**

  **How it surfaced.** The player asked whether Alexander could knock two people unconscious rather than kill them. The honest answer against 1.86 was no. At effective Strength 644 he could not touch an unarmed civilian without a strong chance of killing them - no arrest, no restraint, no sparring, no prisoner - and the *gentlest* delivery available, a mana crystal at Section 7.3's improvised chassis, still computed 322 a projectile against a target with no Rank Health at all. The protagonist is by background a krav maga instructor, a discipline that is mostly control.

  **The rule.** New Section 6.2.1. An attacker may declare a strike **pulled** before the roll - free, no action, no Mana, on any attack he controls, never after a result is known. Damage resolves at **x0.25** through the ordinary formula, with every result multiplier, reduction and injury test applying to the reduced figure. **A target reduced to 0 Health by pulled damage alone is incapacitated rather than killed** and stabilises on its own. The bright line attaches to the source of the damage and never to intent: **any** unpulled contribution to reaching 0 makes it an ordinary death under Section 6.5, which is untouched. It grants no accuracy, no defence and no modifier step, and it does nothing against a monster.

  **Nothing is granted by migrating and no stored value moves** beyond `profile_version`. Pulling is a declaration available to every attacker in the world from adoption forward; it is not a skill, is not learned, is not tracked, and enters no ledger. **No past Event, roll, damage figure, kill or outcome is altered** - every historical resolution was an unpulled strike by construction, because the declaration did not exist to be made. Nothing is retroactively survivable.

  Raised as `F-042`, pinned by `tools/test_gatefall_pulled_strike_contract.ps1`, recorded in `engine/030_ENGINE_CHANGELOG.md` and `worlds/gatefall/migrations/1.86_to_1.87.md`. **The world-side authoring backlog is unchanged at nine** - this closes a gap rather than discharging a backlog item."
```

## EVT-000655 - Four Hours in the Gallery: Who Walked Here, and What the Instance Hangs From

```yaml

description: "Alexander walked the whole flooded system rather than the fighting route - four hours, no opposition left alive in it, deliberate investigation of why this Gate was held rather than cleared. Keen Sense re-cast (1 Mana). **Loner is live and applies to everything he does in here** (no allied hunter shares the Gate) and was applied to both reads; it had been omitted from the prior span's rolls and is corrected forward rather than retroactively.

  **Keen Sense, natural 81 with +3 steps (Perception margin capped, Keen Sense's own step, Loner) -> effective 100, Legendary. Provenance (A rung).** *People have been in here.* Months back at least, thin the way an old trail is thin, unmistakably **human** and **repeated**. The traffic runs from the mouth along one wall, past the bend, and **stops**. It never spreads out. **Nobody in that traffic ever mined a seam** - the deposits Alexander stripped had been untouched for the entire life of this Gate, which for a site somebody spent real capital on is close to insane. They came in, walked one line to the boss, looked at it, and went home. **They were never harvesting it. They were checking on it.**

  **Exploit Pattern, natural 73 with +2 steps (Loner, established capability against an inert structure per `EVT-000612` precedent) -> effective 100, Legendary.** A Pattern established on the instance's own structure. **This Gate does not behave like a Gate.** Section 9.7's shape is a mouth, an interior, a population and a boss whose death collapses the instance - the boss is the load-bearing thing. Here the load is in the wrong place: the gallery's strata carry **the same slow structural pulse as the binding**, same rhythm, same period, faint and everywhere, through walls that should have no rhythm at all. **The binding is not attached to the boss. The boss is attached to the binding, and the whole instance hangs off it.**

  Alexander's own mathematics, running underneath both reads without a die (established capability, `EVT-000353`/`EVT-000372`), draws the inference the reads support: **killing the boss is not how this one closes.** A hunter doing the ordinary correct thing would not collapse a dungeon; he would cut the tether on whatever the tether was put there to hold. A cordon would have made it public and a licensed clear would have killed it, so the operation did the only thing available - built a cold room over the top and left it alone, carefully, forever.

  **This is inference from two Legendary reads, not a System readout**, and the record keeps that distinction: nobody has shown Alexander a rule and he has never seen this Gate's boss die."
```

description: "**Owner ruling taken on a reserved value, at the moment it would otherwise have been resolved by narration.** The player asked directly what happens when the boss dies. `ENT-000167`'s `resolution_depth` had already been ruled once this session (containment rather than extraction, `EVT-000652`) and explicitly reserved *what is bound, why, and by whom*. **What the boss kill does is that same reserved question wearing a different hat** - answering it inside a combat round would have authored the campaign's payoff by accident, so it was stopped for and taken as a ruling, from four options laid out with their costs.

  **Elected: the tether cuts.** The boss dies, **the instance does not collapse**, and what the binding held stops being held. Section 9.7's default - boss death clears the Gate and awards the milestone - **does not govern this Gate**.

  **Two consequences follow immediately and both are recorded rather than left implicit.** Alexander's inference at `EVT-000655` is now **correct**; he still holds no proof, only a Legendary structural read and sound reasoning, and the fiction must keep treating it as a conclusion rather than a certainty. And **the ordinary correct action is the catastrophic one**: any licensed crew that walked in and did its job properly - find the boss, kill it, collect the milestone - would cut it. Wade Bishop sends people into Gates for a living.

  **What remains reserved and deliberately unauthored:** what is bound, why, and by whom. The ruling establishes the *mechanism* of release, not the identity of what is released. Written to `ENT-000167.resolution_depth` in `110_WORLD_LEDGER.md`."
```

## EVT-000657 - The Operation Answers, and the Seventh Anchor

```yaml

description: "**Seven hours after an alert that was not *C-Rank, stable, no change* reached an inbox three shells deep, somebody came.** Rolled rather than asserted - presence on 41+, **natural d100 94**. Two figures crossed the lit rectangle visible through the mouth and stopped.

  **Seventh rift anchor set**, inside the Gate, uncontested and free (Section 6.2's no-roll zone); the price is the exchange held still. Anchors **7 of 32**. Its reach was priced honestly at the table: it returns him to this spot **from anywhere inside this Gate** and will **not** work as a door back in from the city, anchor reach being the same instance, Gate, or contiguous stretch of city (Section 18.8).

  Silent Step re-cast (4 Mana), then eleven metres of flooded gallery to the threshold: **natural 82, +2 steps** (Silent Step, Loner, the one-way sightline from a dim interior into a lit room, less one for the Flooded Mine's standing water taxing exactly this movement) **-> effective 100, Legendary.** No Stat margin was applied and the omission is deliberate - Section 4.3 wants the opposing domain rating and neither figure could be priced before the read.

  **The Flux Sight read, and a Runtime error corrected in the same breath.** The Runtime had twice asserted that Flux Sight does not cross a Gate boundary, and then withheld the read until the player asked for it. **Both were wrong.** Section 4.4 attaches an explicit boundary clause to Keen Sense, Mana Bolt and Flash Step and **none to Flux Sight**; its gate is perception, and the figures were visible. The section is emphatic that it *reads on sight, no roll, no Mana, no activation, no declaration*, that the read fires *the instant a covered subject enters the Bearer's perception*, and that **rendering is not optional** - withholding it pending an action declaration is `F-017`'s fourth item by name. Corrected and rendered at the [S] rung.

  **The woman at the manifold: [B-Rank], HP 600/600, MP 288/300**, carrying **Resonance Survey** (reads a mana structure's shape and load) and **Damping Field** (suppresses an unstable working, sustained), both currently payable. Twelve Mana down - she had already surveyed the sheared manifold before Alexander reached the mouth. **She has not turned that ability on the aperture she is standing eight metres from.**

  **The man at the walkway returns nothing at all.** No Rank, no pools, no line. Flux Sight reads mana-bearing subjects and he is not one: an ordinary unawakened human, in a room built to hold an A-Rank Gate, at four in the morning, with his hands loose at his sides and his back to the thing.

  **Neither has looked at the Gate once**, which is the read that matters: people avoid a thing on purpose when they have been told what it is. The woman finally faced the tear directly and looked straight past Alexander into the green - a lit room looking into a dark one sees a hole and nothing in it. One fragment of her voice carried: *'...how long ago'*.

  **Neither figure is minted as a Persistent Entity.** They have been observed and not spoken to, and the campaign's own precedent (the Lakeline agent at `EVT-000243`, minted only when actually spoken to) governs. **Minting both, with Decision 092 disposition coverage, is owed on first interaction.** The woman's Flux Sight state is recorded here as historical narration rather than as canonical entity state."
```

description: "**Profile 1.87's pulled strike is used in play for the first time, one in-fiction hour after it was authored, for exactly the case that authored it.**

  Alexander declared the attack **pulled** before the roll and fired **Dimensional Projection from inside the Gate at targets standing in the containment room** - 4 Mana, one action, five projectiles split freely. **The boundary was ruled to cross**: Section 7.3's authored text bars only *a sealed barrier* and the launched object is explicitly *a real physical object after withdrawal*, and the mouth is an open aperture he had walked through. The counter-argument was stated rather than buried - the launch carries his mana under `GTF-OVR-003`, and Mana Bolt and Flash Step both name Gate boundaries where this text does not.

  **Loadout, after the player rejected his own first plan on the arithmetic.** He opened by proposing mana crystals for both targets; Section 7.3 prices junk at **weapon power 0 and the improvised chassis x0.5**, giving 322 standard and **81 pulled** - enough for a man holding 40, nowhere near a B-Rank holding 600. Five crystals at standard would have reached 405. He switched to blades on the finding that **Dagger Mastery's `Thrown` (C) category covers a blade launched by Dimensional Projection**, so a projected Quickknife brings its real power and his x2.00 chassis.

  Modifiers: **+2** Agility margin (effective 650 against her [B-Rank] domain rating 40 and his ordinary-adult 10, both capped), **+1 Loner** (no allied hunter shared the Gate and he was still inside it), **-1** Flooded Mine (throwing from standing water taxes Agility). **Net +2.** **Pre-empt (S)** resolved him before both at any Rank.

  Rolls: **49 -> 89 strong x2 = 666 pulled** (Quickknife, the woman); 49 -> 89 strong x2 = 660 (second Quickknife, held); **82 -> 100 critical x4 = 322 pulled** (crystal, the man); reserves 29 and 32 landed standard, unneeded. **The first projectile alone cleared her 600.**

  **Both reached 0 Health by pulled damage alone and neither died.** Section 6.2.1 governs: incapacitated, stabilising on their own, each carrying the injury Section 6.3 assigns. **Pulled overkill is still incapacitation** - the crystal delivered 322 against a body holding 40, eight times the pool, and the section's own migration record names that case in terms. Neither acted; neither perceived him.

  **`Recall and launch` (D) returned every projectile in the same action**, one inventory change, so nothing was left on that floor to photograph. The player's stated reason for preferring a pure-mana attack - leaving no ordinary weapon for them to find - was met by the recall rung rather than by the weapon choice, and the trade was surfaced honestly: **Mana Bolt leaves no object and is a loud mana event next to the only anomaly instrument in the building; a recalled blade leaves nothing and is quiet on that instrument.**

  **`ENT-000213` and `ENT-000214` minted here.** Both were observed at `EVT-000657` and deliberately not minted then, on the campaign's own precedent that an unspoken-to figure waits; **being rendered unconscious by the protagonist is past that line.** Disposition authored under Decision 092, both records postdating `disposition_baseline: ENT-000210`."
```

## EVT-000660 - The Instrument, and the Number It Should Not Be Able to Show

```yaml
id: EVT-000660
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active
provenance:
  source: session-gameplay
  game_date: "2026-08-23 03:59 -05:00"

  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.rift_step.successful_uses, delta: 1 }

    domain: gatefall.skill_formation

    domain: gatefall.skill_credit

participation_audits:

    result: record-updated
    record: REC-000074
description: "Alexander took the woman's hand-instrument off the containment-room floor into the dimensional inventory - Section 12.9 storage reaching what he perceives, the device dropped rather than held, the open mouth not a barrier he cannot perceive through. **That was Silent Step's second manipulation and the concealment dropped**; he re-cast it (4 Mana) for the cameras rather than for the two unconscious people.

  **The screen was live for the half-second it took to go, and it is the largest single fact this thread has produced.** She had been pointing it at the Gate when she was dropped and the cycle had completed. For eleven weeks that instrument reported **C-Rank, stable, no change**, twice a day, to an operation that believed it. With no plant on the manifold and nothing running in the slab, the reading has gone **past the top of its own scale and pinned there**.

  **Which reframes what the plant was.** It was never only cooling. **It was holding the signature down**, and eleven weeks of *no change* was the lid talking rather than the thing beneath it. Hollis Rennard measured a working lid every day of her employment. Tonight somebody measured it without one, and then said a short sentence to a man who put both hands on his head.

  Alexander crossed the mouth - **the only exit, since anchor reach does not cross a Gate boundary** - and rift-stepped from the containment room to the apartment anchor, 5 Mana on the E-Rank city ladder (`EVT-000521`). **He left both of them where they lay.**

  **A Runtime authoring error is retracted here rather than carried.** Owen Callahan was narrated awake at 04:00 with a light on and a kettle going, and had earlier been given a **06:00** boat departure he 'would not move' - **both invented by the Runtime and neither supported by his record.** `EVT-000243` has him carried from a couch to a bed **without waking**, and `EVT-000386` puts him asleep or nearly **at 06:00 on a Saturday in this same flat**. Canon holds *tomorrow morning, the boat, with Owen* and no hour at all. **The 06:00 departure is struck, the two-hour clock cited across several exchanges never existed, and the flat is dark.** Same class as the phantom twenty B-Rank cores removed at `EVT-000638`: a detail matching no grounded holding, treated as a real thread. Player-caught."
```

## EVT-000662 - Profile 1.88 Adopted: An Owned Thing That Is Somewhere Else

```yaml
id: EVT-000662
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active
provenance:
  source: session-gameplay
