    domain: gatefall.skill_formation
    result: none
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_credit
    result: none
participation_audits:
  - subject: ENT-000125
    result: record-updated
    record: REC-000074
description: "**Gatefall World Rule Profile 1.87 -> 1.88 adopted at the campaign's current anchor**, the world side having landed as an engine change that deliberately left this Event owed.

  **The defect.** Section 12.9 opened *'Every item he owns lives there **unless he has chosen to hold or wear it**'* - exhaustive by construction, two dispositions, and the world routinely produces a third: an object the Bearer still owns that is **physically in a named party's hands**. A grep of 1.87 for `custody` returned zero. **So the ledger deleted it.** `EVT-000636` removed the heartwood core-mass and the frost-fused carapace plating from this very character sheet because both sat in Priscilla Nakamura's custody. That repair was correct *given the model* - the sheet had been rendering them as held inventory, equally false, and one had already misrendered in a `/system gear` panel. **The model offered two answers and both were wrong.**

  **What the panel was omitting by 1.87:** a **Dormant Core [S-Rank]**, the highest-Rank object in this campaign; a heartwood core-mass; a frost-fused carapace plating [B-Rank]; three C-Rank Mana Crystals; and a Seer's Lens [D-Rank] pair taken out of play by an open fusion. **Six holdings, none sold, none given away, all still his, none visible to him.**

  **The rule.** New Section 12.9 clause and a sixth **`IN CUSTODY`** group at Section 15.3.2. Ownership never moves - **possession, never title**. A record names **who holds it, since when, and what ends it**, and is invalid without all three. The item renders in the custody group **instead of** its kind group, never both.

  **The load-bearing clause is the exclusion rather than the display.** A custodied item is **not a legal target for Section 12.9 remote storage** - *despite* satisfying that clause's bare wording, a core on a bench being genuinely unheld by anyone - because **he consented to it being there**. Recovery is an act in the fiction with whatever it costs, never a free thought. A custody a Bearer can silently reverse is not a custody, and an artificer who can be robbed by a man thinking about it has no reason to accept work.

  **Nothing is granted by migrating and no stored value moves** beyond `profile_version` and an empty `inventory.custody` list. No past Event, roll, kill or outcome is altered, including `EVT-000636`, which stands as the historical record of what was decided under a two-state model.

  Raised as `F-043`, pinned by `tools/test_gatefall_custody_contract.ps1`, recorded in `engine/030_ENGINE_CHANGELOG.md` and `worlds/gatefall/migrations/1.87_to_1.88.md`. **The world-side authoring backlog is unchanged at nine.**"
```

Departed from the Rogers Park flat with Owen asleep behind a closed door, consistent with `EVT-000620`'s discipline. **His arrival registered on the Scar's perimeter exactly as it did on 2026-08-20** - indistinguishable from a decade of unexplained spikes BGM waves off - which is settled canon from `EVT-000554` and was read rather than re-rolled.

The [S] rung returns what it is FOR: **watching. It does not suppress, contain or damp. There is no lid on anything here.**

  **Exploit Pattern, deliberate structural read: natural 82, +2 steps (Intelligence margin 693 vs unranked 10) -> effective 100, LEGENDARY.** Three findings. **The instrument is not aimed at the warp zone; it is aimed DOWN**, sited and mounted to read the sealed bay under the block. **Its mounting has weathered for the better part of a decade**, which puts it there while BGM was still calling the Scar managed and makes the Meridian warehouse installation - eleven weeks old by Hollis Rennard's own duty-cycle log - the NEWER of the two. And **the interval between spikes is shorter now than the older marks on its own mounting record**: the same shape as a containment failing.

What it carries now is a figure for the thing beneath his feet, climbing while the cycle ran. No copy was ever made.

Natural **33**, net 0 steps - **the mana-null disc masks what reads through the slab it is pressed to, not an emitter of his own, and the Suppression Emitter was not activated** - effective 33, **Failure**. **It registered.** The layer that reacted to his Emitter here on 2026-08-20 and inside the Meridian fence at `EVT-000541` logged an active instrument signature at the warp heart. For the second time in seven hours, a site that reports nothing has reported something.

Rendered as **What Never Finished Arriving**. **Reward 1,500 XP** - repriced from 700 by Profile 1.89 before it settled. **XP 3,017 -> 4,517/4,300 -> LEVEL 44**, carry 217/4,400. Not a decade level - no Title Assessment, no fifth slot; the next is level 50, which is also System Rank S.

The same shape as `EVT-000656`'s finding that Section 9.7 does not govern the Meridian Gate: **the rules this world wrote for Gates do not recognise this thing at all.** Minted `ENT-000217`.

  **He arrives standing and the floor is gone** - a surface that takes weight and returns nothing, no grain, no cold, no sound underfoot. The torch cone **ends** about six metres out rather than fading. No smell, no temperature, and a very slight continuous movement all in one direction, like a held breath being let out over ten years. Nothing touched him; Health and Mana never moved except for the step.

  **Flux Sight returns nothing here at all. No subject resolved.**

  **From this side the arrival is a cross-section.** What reads from the sublevel as a four-metre lightless edge folded into concrete is the **leading face** of a bulk that goes back past the range the torch reaches. **What has arrived in ten years is a fraction of it.**

  **He is off the anchor network and priced it before stepping.** Section 18.8 scopes anchor reach to the same instance, Gate or contiguous stretch of the city; this volume is none, exactly as every anchor went out of reach inside the Meridian Gate six hours earlier. **The line-of-sight step still works and needs no sight at System Rank A**, so the sublevel floor stays a legal destination at 6 Mana. He is not trapped.

  **Ninety-one paces, counted.** A physicist's own measured pace and a running total, because **rift-step reaches a hundred metres and the bay floor is the only point he knows how to stand on**. The cross-section never ends, never tapers, never seams. At eighty he establishes that the drift runs ALONG the face, one direction, the same direction ten years have run in.

  **At ninety-one paces: a second face.** Two metres, maybe less, pressing out of the same bulk at an angle unrelated to the bay he came from, with **worked stone caught in its edge, and it is wet**. Cold air threads through where the seal is imperfect. It smells of standing water and cut mineral - **which he had spent four hours walking eleven miles away, on the flooded side of the Meridian Gate, the same night**. Not confirmed: nothing crossed it, and Flux Sight gives nothing from this side.

  **Then a pulse, and it settles the structure.** Behind him at the first face the bulk gains - another increment into a basement under Cicero - and **at the same instant the wet stone at the second face gives.** One event, two faces. **It is not arriving in two places; it is arriving THROUGH two places, and one of them is a Gate somebody built a cold room around and has been counting for eleven weeks.**

  Anchor 04:33 -> 04:42. 6 Mana spent."
```

## EVT-000669 - Profile 1.89 -> 1.90 Adopted

```yaml
id: EVT-000669
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active
provenance:
  source: owner-ruling
  game_date: "2026-08-23 04:42 -05:00"

kind: ruling
importance: pivotal

participants:
  - ENT-000125
counter_deltas: []
progression_audits:
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_formation
    result: none
participation_audits:
  - subject: ENT-000125
    result: record-updated
    record: ENT-000125
description: "**Two owner rulings, adopted as Gatefall World Rule Profile 1.90.** `canonical_state.system_state.profile_version` 1.89 -> 1.90. Migration `worlds/gatefall/migrations/1.89_to_1.90.md`, classification **compatibility-treatment**: no fictional time, no rolls, **no stored value moved** beyond the version field itself. Both rules are prospective from this instant.

  **1. Section 8.4.2's Bearer-exclusion is scoped to instances.** *The Bearer is never the imperilled person* was written whole, on the reasoning that danger to a hunter's life is the work he signed for - true inside an aperture, and false on a street. **Inside a Gate, a Section 9.6 red gate or a Section 17 instant dungeon it is unchanged.** Outside one, **he satisfies criterion 1 himself**, and criterion 2 widens for that case alone to any immediate lethal threat he directly perceives, **including an awakened human acting to kill him**. Two standing clauses now carry the anti-abuse weight: a danger he deliberately created still disqualifies - the test being who initiated lethal intent, not who struck first - and the contract exclusion now reaches him as well as his crew. **The solo-instance case is untouched**: a private instant dungeon still produces no Urgent quest, deliberately. Reward unchanged at the Section 3.4 milestone one Rank above his System Rank, so **3,200 XP at System Rank A**.

  **2. New Section 7.6, Succession.** A personally killed **awakened human** leaves **one** transcribable technique. Signature only; never a Section 4.4 Stat Passive, never a Section 18 class ability; the Bearer's own damage must have crossed the Section 6.5 threshold, and **a target put down by a pulled strike under Section 6.2.1 is alive and leaves nothing**. It enters at the victim's Rank **clamped to Section 7.5's System-Rank+1 ceiling**, at **Novice**, counters at zero, Mana cost from the arriving Rank's ladder. Already held: nothing is taken. **No magnitude is invented** - the clamp, the reset and the cost ladder are existing law; 1.90 adds a route, the third after evidence and runes and the only instant one.

  **The price is not mechanical and that is deliberate.** Sections 19 and 20.4 already author exposure and law: a licensed hunter's death is investigable, and a transcribed technique is evidence in the killer's own ledger. **Nothing about this campaign's fiction changes tonight** - Alexander has killed no awakened human and is standing in a volume with nobody else in it. What changed is what the world will pay him for, and what he could take.

  Repository side: `tools/test_gatefall_succession_contract.ps1` added, the quest-contract gate's Bearer-exclusion legs rewritten to assert the new scope, full suite green at 47 of 47. Engine changelog `engine/030_ENGINE_CHANGELOG.md`, 2026-08-21."
```

  The read comes back wrong in a useful way. He has been walking what he assumed was a corridor with two ends; it has neither. The count of faces is not two - bearings scatter off the line he actually walked, meaning the structure branches in ways ninety-one straight paces never suggested.   Standing Watch settles onto the place as the read closes - a live disagreement between his own two instruments, and a pulse arrives sooner than the last one while he is still turning it over. He has the cadence now, and has just watched it contract in front of him."
```

Flux Sight (unprompted) and Keen Sense: natural 63, +3 -> effective 100, Legendary; Mana 1, pools 1,503 -> 1,502/1,512. Read C-Rank, genuine warmth rather than pure careerism, and — through concealment — that the Director herself is not on-site today, which Laurel admitted rather than oversold. Offered fifteen minutes with the Assistant Director for External Coordination instead of a false promise; accepted.

Flux Sight (unprompted) and Keen Sense: natural 44, +3 -> effective 100, Legendary; Mana 1, pools 1,502 -> 1,501/1,512. Read D-Rank, genuine intent, and — by provenance on his own rehearsed posture — that he has negotiated with at least one other confirmed S-Rank before.

  **Alexander stated his goal plainly: to break apart the guild system**, Horizon and Ironline both, citing witnessed danger to hunters the guilds profit from underinvesting in. Farraday named BGM's real ceiling — no statutory authority to dissolve a guild, only to build a regulatory case from evidence — and offered formal cooperating-source status plus real whistleblower immunity (prosecution immunity for disclosed material, retaliation made actionable, safe non-public intake) for an Ironline insider, routed through the compliance review already active on the Ironline roster. Alexander named Wade Bishop, and confirmed on inquiry that Wade had not yet consented — offered to arrange it rather than claim it done.

  **The standing arrangement, negotiated in full.** Alexander accepted: availability as a compensated, declinable Gate-incident responder for confirmed high-Rank emergencies. Alexander refused: any broader reporting or transparency obligation. Alexander accepted, narrowed: advance notice to BGM before moving against a guild, in exchange for BGM channeling guild reform through evidence and hearings rather than Alexander acting unilaterally. Farraday accepted the narrower deal as struck. No live Gate incident existed to respond to as of this conversation.

  Left the building; the auction floor (Gate clearance contracts only, business days) was checked and found closed for the weekend, Friday's board frozen and unremarkable."

```yaml

description: "Kissed Owen without waking him and took the call from the kitchen. **Kesha Morrison** picked up on the second ring, which at six in the morning means she was already awake, and had the file out before she spoke.\n\n  **What she had.** BGM Region V pushed an amended registration to every coordinator holding Alexander's contract history the previous evening - card status change effective 2026-08-23, witnessed twice, reawakened classification, **S-Rank**. Her channel is role-based records access, which her `knowledge` block already authorises; nothing here reaches the Profile 14.4.1 register and nothing was disclosed to her that would. Nineteen years at the desk and she has never filed a card change past B. She asked, before anything procedural, whether he was alright - *that's not the desk asking.*\n\n  **What she told him, unprompted and against her own interest.** Cancelling his Coalition affiliation buys him no cover: the registration already went to Horizon's and Ironline's compliance desks along with hers, and **Section 9.4 puts no S-Rank on a co-op board at all** - state-directed, contract by contract. All cancelling would cost him is the one desk in the city that has never tried to own him. She named that as her honest answer rather than the one that keeps him on her roster, and handed him the actual choice: **active**, or *inactive, contract-independent*, either filed today.\n\n  **What he chose.** Active - reasoning aloud that the Coalition can take a cut if anyone offers him a proper job, and telling her warmly that managing an S-Rank would probably bump her up too. She laughed at that and did not entirely deny it. **A standing intake filter was set and read back verbatim: nothing below A-Rank; exceptions only for genuinely out-of-pattern work, or anything abroad at any Rank - he asked for foreign work specifically.** She refused the vaguer version (*'interesting' isn't a category I can hold a posting against*) and made him state it in terms she could file. Consequence recorded on the supply source: **all seven live board postings now sit below his filter.**\n\n  **Then he told her the voicemail's contents in full.** Her read, in order: Vance did the right thing calling first and that buys him something; a named source inside Region V talking within sixteen hours means it was *given*, not leaked, and those are different problems; she has no name for him and would not hand one over if she did. Her advice, neither taken nor refused: don't call cold, don't ignore her either, because silence means she runs it uncontested and *'confirmed S-Rank hunter declined to comment'* reads worse than anything true. She offered **Marguerite** (`ENT-000225`), an independent media liaison who works for hunters rather than institutions and has handled this exact call for two prior reclassifications. **Alexander accepted and asked her to pass his contact.** She undertook to have Marguerite ring him by end of day, told him to eat something before BGM, and hung up first, as she always does.\n\n  **Two pending world-side commitments recorded** in `110_WORLD_LEDGER.md`, both due end of day 2026-08-24 - the Marguerite introduction, and the reclassification-plus-filter filing. **This is the first live instance of the Decision 082 construct in this campaign**; the section did not previously exist, which is the defect `tools/list_commitment_candidates.ps1` was written against. `ENT-000225` minted, deliberately thin: named, not met, disposition unauthored because no contact has occurred."
```

Population 🎲 3d6 11 commons, 🎲 1d2 1 elite +1 shrine guardian = **2 elites**, 1 boss, all A-Rank. Rupture twice (a common, then the boss), Twin Fang once, Micro-rift deflection once - turning a closing common aside into the beast behind it. Dagger Mastery applied materially on the Twin Fang action. **Nothing rolled against him. Nothing landed. No die resolved against the Bearer at any point in the instance.**\n\n  Loot. Deposit 🎲 3d6 10 x the A-Rank multiplier 16, **+2 Prospector** = **162 crystals**, worked out across the remainder of the window; 11 more off the kills; 3 A-Rank cores (2 elites + boss). Boss drop 🎲 d100 96 -> skill book, 🎲 d10 9 -> **Rupture [A-Rank]** - redundant, he holds it at [S-Rank], so Section 7.1's known-at-or-above branch leaves it **intact and unconsumed** with no reroll. The Runic Key's own guarantee resolved separately: 🎲 d8 6 -> a **Keen Sense [A-Rank]** rune, also redundant, also intact. **Both are `unbound-awakened` under Section 7.1's instant-dungeon provenance rule**, which is what makes them worth keeping - the first instruction he holds that he could hand to another awakened without having bought it for that purpose. Shrine bonus loot 🎲 d100 85 -> a second **Instant-Dungeon Key [A-Rank]**, unopened.\n\n  XP: 11 commons x 400 + 2 elites x 800 + 1 boss x 1,600 + the A-Rank clear milestone 1,500 = **9,100**, no underdog multiplier (the creatures stand at his own System Rank). Against 217/4,400 that crosses **LEVEL 44 -> 45 -> 46**, each paying the A-Rank rung's +63 to every base Stat and +5 ability points, each restoring both pools to their new maxima. Closes 417/4,600.\n\n  **`gatefall.skill_credit` classifies `none`, and it is the correct classification rather than a technicality.** Section 7.4 requires genuine dangerous-scene contributions for a combat skill's mastery; nothing acted against him and nothing was rolled against him, which is the identical test this campaign settled at `EVT-000527`, `EVT-000560`, `EVT-000574`, `EVT-000599`, `EVT-000667` and `EVT-000676`. Successful-use counters move; no qualifying scene does; no mastery advances. He spent this key precisely because it was beneath him. **The structural consequence is raised as `F-046`.**"

Neither is the terms.'* - and then, pressed angrily, named the actual complaint without heat: **nobody had called Farraday since the night Wade agreed.** The immunity Farraday offered at `EVT-000684` existed as an offer and had never been converted into a document, and Wade would not walk into a federal building on a promise after three recruits died on his own thin rosters.

  **A Runtime citation error was caught by the player here and corrected in `170_CHANGELOG.md` rather than buried.** The changelog's compressed summary of `EVT-000684` read *'Alexander named Wade Bishop'*; `ENT-000223`'s own `agenda` and `knowledge` fields have always read *'an Ironline insider (Wade Bishop, not yet named to him)'*. **The entity record was right and the summary was wrong.** Alexander had referred to his source only as 'they' throughout that negotiation - no name, no gender given.

  **Alexander went to Wade instead of waiting.** Texted the change of plan rather than presenting it, met him on the BGM steps twenty-two minutes later, and walked in beside him - the stated point being that Farraday does not get to treat this as a courtesy call when the S-Rank who negotiated the arrangement is standing in the room.

  **Farraday named his own ceiling honestly before being pushed.** No paper existed; statutory immunity does not draft itself in the time it takes to walk across the Loop. What he offered instead was a signed letter of intent from his own office, binding on BGM's side, formal filing to follow inside the week. **Alexander refused it** - *'Before the official immunity, there is no deal'* - and, when Farraday named that as an ultimatum, corrected him: *'That's not ultimatum, that's the terms we agreed on.'*

  **Farraday called the Director rather than defending the gap.** Off-site, not unreachable. Ninety seconds of Farraday laying it out - the reclassification, the standing arrangement, an insider physically present with terms he named himself, an unaffiliated S-Rank vouching in person rather than through channels - and one point where he declined to speak for Alexander (*'That's his own concern, not mine to promise on'*). **Result: the Director's personal verbal sign-off, confirmed to Farraday and committed to writing before Wade left the building, with the full statutory filing by end of week on the terms already given** - immunity from prosecution on disclosed material, retaliation made actionable, safe intake outside the public queue.

  **Wade accepted it and named why.** Not the immunity itself - *'whether it would still be real in six weeks when nobody is watching'* - and the Director's name is what answers that. He went to give his statement to Farraday's office with the printed sheet in hand. **Alexander did not stay for it.**"

description: "**Rift-step to the fence-line anchor and ten minutes on foot to the shop** - the ordinary approach, no concealment needed for a partner's front door. **Tenth anchor set** just inside it, uncontested and free.

  **`OBJ-29`'s first demonstrable result, delivered on its due date and smaller than it looked.** Storage secured two blocks over, paid through the month; one of two vouched people confirmed and starting Friday; two calls made to mana-touched-goods dealers signalling a bigger buyer, one already asking who is backing it, unanswered on purpose. **No stock moving, and Walt named that as deliberate rather than slow**: inventory before security is how a first bad night ends an operation, and the buyer's question is exactly the door he will not open without a story that is not Alexander's name.

  **Pressed on it - *'not this slow'* - he priced speed honestly instead of promising it.** Three things buy it: a **cover for the capital** (cash that appeared attracts the curiosity the whole build exists to avoid - a shell or a licensed side business with paper behind it); the **second vouched person locked** rather than deciding, which he has been letting take her own time on purpose; and **stock bought outright**, faster than brokering and bigger single moments where somebody could ask a question. *'Give me those three and I go from slow yes to something real inside a week instead of a month.'*

  **Alexander declined to run any of it** - *'That's your job to secure those three, we agreed on it, I am putting money and crystals, you're doing the business'* - and Walt took it without argument, naming that he had been explaining what the money buys rather than asking for help spending it. He committed to the cover, the real offer to the second vouch this week, and stock only once both are solid. **The standing term holds: anything carrying real money or real risk, Alexander hears before it happens.**

  **A piece appraised, and declined.** An unidentified wrist-guard off a retiring Coalition freelancer, asked at $800 as-is. **Flux Sight with The Unmeasured read it in full without a roll**: [D-Rank], Perception +2, and a passive warning charm - a half-second of wrongness before something closes with hostile intent - **ceiling C-Rank, one Rank of unused headroom**. **Alexander did not buy it**, and then asked the question that mattered more than the item: whether Walt would change a price on a partner who had just told him what it was. **Walt refused the premise flatly** - a partner who gets punished for telling the truth stops telling it, and he is worse off every time after.

  **A standing arrangement, offered and taken: Alexander appraises anything Walt cannot identify himself, free.** Walt named its real value immediately - appraisal costs him money on half of what comes through the door, and every unidentified piece he has been discounting for his own risk can now be priced closer to true. **He said the quiet thing too**: *'You keep doing things that make this look like it was the right call to trust you. I noticed that a while ago. Still noticing it.'*

  **Alexander flagged that he will be busy, may come at odd hours, and wants the business to prosper anyway.** Walt: the door is his whether the sign is on or not, and *'I want it prospering same as you do - that's not a partner's line, that's Nadia's line, whether I say her name or not.'*"

Call tomorrow in business hours, lead with the ordinary version, and **offer the on-record quote before she has to dig for one**, since a quote she did not fight for is a quote she runs straight. ## EVT-000707 - Loomis Street, Floor Four: An Assessment Overheard

```yaml
id: EVT-000707
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active
provenance:
  source: session-gameplay
  game_date: "2026-08-25 07:30-08:10 -05:00"

  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.keen_sense.successful_uses, delta: 1 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.exploit_pattern.successful_uses, delta: 1 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.rift_step.successful_uses, delta: 1 }
description: "**The building that has been read from the pavement twice was entered through its front door.** A Runtime correction landed first and is recorded rather than buried: Alexander proposed rift-stepping to an elevator on a known floor, and **no floor was known** - `EVT-000372`'s legendary Keen Sense read established the building's posture and concealment from a public street, never its interior. Rift-step reaches a point seen or personally stood in; it does not gamble on an unperceived interior. **The plan was corrected before it resolved rather than after.**

  **The lobby, and the badge fragment's own language used as a key.** He walked in and said *'CONSULT - TEMP'* like a man who had said it a hundred times. **Acting Perception 927 against a trained security professional (domain rating 20, +2 stat margin cap): natural 78, +2 steps -> effective 100, Legendary.** The guard barely looked up. *'Consult's on four. Elevator's behind me, badge reader's broken so just go on up.'* **No suspicion, no call upstairs, no second question** - the phrase is common enough inside that building that a stranger saying it does not register as an event.

  **Silent Step in the elevator** (Mana 4), concealment holding the ride and beyond.

  **Floor four, read.** Keen Sense (Mana 1), **natural 32, +3 steps -> effective 92, Strong**: a reception desk with one woman on a headset and an unused sign-in tablet; two glass-walled meeting rooms standing empty; **three closed windowless consultation rooms**, furnished for exactly the unhurried private conversation Walt described Marnie's own meetings being; and **a sixth room at the corridor's end with a heavier door, no glass, and a keypad.** On the desk, a sign-in log mostly blank, its last entry six days old with no company field filled in. **Voices behind the keypad door, more than one.**

  **The eleventh anchor set** standing a full exchange inside an empty meeting room, uncontested and free, while Exploit Pattern read through the wall.

  **Exploit Pattern on the sixth room: natural 94, +3 -> effective 100, Legendary.** Cadence through a door is still a Pattern. **Two voices, and the shape resolved clean.** One **conducts** - unhurried, evenly spaced questions, the register of someone bored by how well this always goes. One **answers badly** - too fast, over-explaining, nerves it has not learned to hide. Fragments carried: *'the commission stands on its own, the client doesn't need to know who actually-'* and, flatter: *'That's not what I asked. Walk me through the working again. From the seating, not from the finish.'*

  **It is an assessment.** Someone's work being examined piece by piece by someone who already knows the right answer and is watching whether the maker reaches it - **the same shape of request Marnie herself specialised in taking.** Pattern established and live for the scene.

  **Held position and kept listening rather than pushing.** More surfaced: *'the client believes it's your hand start to finish. That's the arrangement. You understand what happens to the arrangement if that stops being true.'* Answered quietly: *'I understand.'* **No name spoken, nothing confirming Marnie specifically** - the shape is what carries, not an identification.

  **The door opened.** The second voice came out first - **`ENT-000226`, minted here**, early thirties, a leather satchel held close, exactly as rattled as the Pattern read him, walking past within arm's reach without a glance. Behind him, unhurried and pleasant, the conductor's parting line: *'Careful with the satchel. That one's worth more than you are.'*

  **A name-collision check ran mid-scene and caught a reuse.** The conductor's line originally named a *Priyanka*, colliding with Priyanka Osei from Wade Bishop's forged Ironline roster (`EVT-000380`); `tools/check_name_collision.ps1` flagged the surname and the line was re-authored to **Delphine** (`ENT-000229`, named only, never seen) before it became load-bearing."
```

## EVT-000708 - The Satchel Taken, and a Tail Across the City

```yaml
id: EVT-000708
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active
provenance:
  source: session-gameplay
  game_date: "2026-08-25 08:10-08:45 -05:00"
  real_date: "2026-08-25"
type: Event
kind: pursuit
importance: pivotal
game_date: "2026-08-25 08:10-08:45 -05:00"
participants:
  - ENT-000125
  - ENT-000226
counter_deltas:
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.rift_step.successful_uses, delta: 2 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.sprint.successful_uses, delta: 1 }
description: "**Rift-step to the street** (Mana 6) - a legitimate target, the entrance being ground he had personally stood on minutes earlier, unlike the corrected interior guess. Beat the elevator down; concealment held through the crossing and nobody on the street reacted to a man existing where he had not been.

  **Ninety seconds later `ENT-000226` came out**, checked the street once too fast to read as anything but nerves, and set off north.

  **The satchel taken from his own grip, mid-stride.** Acting **Agility 965** against an ordinary civilian's hold (domain rating 10, +2 stat margin cap): **natural 73, +2 steps -> effective 100, Legendary.** Not a tear or a yank - **withdrawn into the dimensional inventory** so cleanly there was nothing to feel. **Silent Step's `Concealment through action` (D) covered the manipulation**, its one allowance spent here.

  **He noticed four steps later**, and the reaction was not subtle: stopped dead, spun scanning the street behind him, patted himself down twice, checked the ground and behind a parked car, then stood working out what happens next.

  **Then he called it in**, hands shaking enough to fumble the unlock. His side of it, overheard: *'It's gone. I don't - no, I didn't set it down, I had it the whole-'* ... *'I don't know how, that's what I'm telling you, one second it was there and then-'* ... and, drained: *'Okay. Okay, I'll - where do you want me.'* **He was given a location rather than reassurance.**

  **The tail.** He moved fast through side streets, then flagged a cab. **A second Runtime correction landed and is recorded**: Alexander proposed rift-stepping repeatedly to match the cab, and rift-step is **once per exchange** - one cast to a point within 100 m, not a continuous movement mode. Corrected before it resolved. **One rift-step ahead of the cab's visible route, then Sprint** (Mana 6 + 4) carrying the rest on foot, with the established Pattern reading which turns a panicking man takes. **No roll: the gap between a determined S-Rank on foot and a cab in city traffic is not genuinely uncertain** (Rules Section 4.2).

  **Destination: Ironclad Self Storage** (`ENT-000230`, minted), near west side - keypad gate, rows of identical roll-up doors. **He keyed the code from memory rather than checking a phone**, which is a man who has been here more than once. **The same category of place Rosalind Fenn has been chasing on the Marnie thread** since `EVT-000490` - a storage unit, cash-paid, prepaid through October - though not confirmed the same unit.

  **Suppression Emitter activated** against the possibility of an undisclosed anomaly-sensing layer, the same precaution the fenced warehouse taught at `EVT-000541`. **The mana-null disc was not available**: it carries as spent since `EVT-000666`, its ten-minute window used at the Cicero warp heart, and the record authors no recharge cycle. **A correction was taken here on the player's challenge** - the disc had been carried as *left at the Cicero Scar, not retrieved*, and an item deliberately deployed at a site already flagged as watched is one he would go back for. **Retrieved off-screen; the sheet now carries it as held-but-spent rather than lost.**

  **Rift-step inside the gate** (Mana 6), a dozen metres behind him."
```

## EVT-000709 - COMPLETE, and the Man Who Decides

```yaml
id: EVT-000709
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active
provenance:
  source: session-gameplay
  game_date: "2026-08-25 08:45-09:20 -05:00"
  real_date: "2026-08-25"
type: Event
kind: discovery
importance: pivotal
game_date: "2026-08-25 08:45-09:20 -05:00"
participants:
  - ENT-000125
  - ENT-000226
counter_deltas:
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.silent_step.successful_uses, delta: 1 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.silent_step.qualifying_scenes_total, delta: 1 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.keen_sense.successful_uses, delta: 1 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.keen_sense.qualifying_scenes_total, delta: 1 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.exploit_pattern.successful_uses, delta: 1 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.exploit_pattern.qualifying_scenes_total, delta: 1 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.flux_sight.successful_uses, delta: 2 }
participation_audits:
  - subject: ENT-000125
    result: record-updated
    record: ENT-000125
  - subject: ENT-000226
    result: record-updated
    record: ENT-000226
description: "**Slipped in behind him before the door came down.** The unit is not storage in the ordinary sense: **shelving both walls, a dozen worked pieces** in varying states, finished and wrapped or laid out mid-commission on cloth like a bench would hold them. **An open ledger on a folding table** - handwritten, working aliases rather than names, cross-referenced against dates, client codes and percentage figures.

  **One entry caught before he flipped past it**: an alias, a date three weeks old, and beside it in different handwriting a single word underlined twice - **`COMPLETE`.** No entry after it. **The date lines up almost exactly with when Marnie went quiet.**

  **The twelfth anchor set** standing the exchange while he searched, concealment holding.

  **What stopped him was three pages further back**: another alias, another date six weeks older, the same word underlined the same way - and in the margin, smaller, added later in a different pen: **`2nd time this qtr. Flag for D.`** He was not reading one entry; he was doing the arithmetic on a pattern.

  **He texted rather than called**: *'How many of these are there. I need to know if I'm actually safe here.'* **The reply took four minutes**: *'You're overthinking a filing note. Bring the satchel Thursday and we'll talk about what actually happened to it. - D'* **`ENT-000228` enters canon as a signature and nothing else** - a person who decides, coded, unnamed, and unbothered.

  **The analytical read, and it is the session's largest single finding.** Keen Sense live for the scene, Pattern established: **natural 85, +3 steps -> effective 100, Legendary.**

  - **CONSULT is a controller, not a consultancy.** It finds unlicensed artificers good enough to be worth owning, runs their work through anonymous commissions - *'the client believes it's your hand start to finish'* - and keeps them producing under a name that is not theirs. The ledger tracks aliases, never identities.
  - **`COMPLETE` is a threshold, not a project status.** Every entry carrying it sits beside that maker's **best** recorded piece rather than their most recent. **It marks the moment a maker proves they no longer need CONSULT** - and Marnie finished an S-Rank blade that is the best work Priscilla Nakamura has held in a decade, then never came back for it (`EVT-000592`'s ceiling finding, which established she was not taken mid-work).
  - **`Flag for D` means a person makes a judgment call**, repeatedly, on makers who have just proven they are too good to keep. Not a rule. A decision, taken more than once this quarter alone.
  - **What it does not establish**: whether *handled* means relocated, bought off, silenced or worse. The ledger records the **decision point**, never the outcome. And it gives no name for D.

  **Flux Sight on `ENT-000226`, automatic and no roll**: **D-Rank per card, Health and Mana both intact, no injury.** Whatever CONSULT does to the people who cross that line, it has left no mark on this one. **He is rattled, not hurt, and entirely ordinary by every instrument Alexander carries.**

  **Keen Sense on the room** (Mana 1), **natural 10, +3 -> effective 70, ordinary success - a partial read and recorded as one**: a consumer-grade camera low behind the shelving, the facility's own rather than CONSULT's, angled at the door and not the ledger table; a second exit at the back wall, unlocked, worn from use; nobody else present. **Nothing dangerous is physically in this room. What is dangerous about this operation is D, and D is somewhere else.**

  **The wallet lifted while he worked the door.** **Silent Step recast first** (Mana 4) - the player had standing intent to recast when needed and it was under-surfaced by the Runtime before the roll; **corrected, and the recast reset `Concealment through action`'s one-manipulation allowance so concealment held through this take too.** Acting Agility 965, +2 stat margin, **+1 for genuinely exploiting the established Pattern on his distraction: natural 41, +3 steps -> effective 100, Legendary.** He never broke stride.

  **Identity established: `ENT-000226` - Peter Kwiatkowski**, BGM-issued ID, **licensed D-Rank, no combat rating on file**, a residential address on the near northwest side, cash, ordinary receipts, an **expired Coalition membership card**. **Nothing naming CONSULT and nothing naming D** - the operation keeps its people's paperwork boring on purpose. **The expired Coalition card is the live lead**: Kesha Morrison's desk would hold a contact number against that member ID even after a lapse."
```

## EVT-000710 - Five Makers, and a Manifest Under the Floor

```yaml
id: EVT-000710
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active
provenance:
  source: session-gameplay
  game_date: "2026-08-25 09:20-09:50 -05:00"
  real_date: "2026-08-25"
type: Event
kind: acquisition
importance: pivotal
game_date: "2026-08-25 09:20-09:50 -05:00"
participants:
  - ENT-000125
counter_deltas:
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.rift_step.successful_uses, delta: 1 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.keen_sense.successful_uses, delta: 3 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.flux_sight.successful_uses, delta: 5 }
description: "**The satchel opened, and it was a container rather than a thing.** An ordinary well-made bag, no Rank and no function of its own. **The conductor's *'worth more than you are'* was about its contents.** Inside, wrapped in oilcloth: a **worked bracer [B-Rank]**, **Agility +9**, no combat multiplier or reduction line. **Flux Sight with The Unmeasured read its ceiling at A-Rank** and found the reason it matters - **a second property built into the metalwork and never activated**, a latent passive dormant until the piece is carried to that ceiling. **Nobody finished it, so what it does is unread.** The maker's mark stamped inside is **confirmed not Marnie's hand** - a second controlled artificer, established physically rather than inferred from a ledger line.

  **Rift-step back to the unit's anchor** (Mana 6) after Kwiatkowski locked up and left, the door being no obstacle to ground already held.

  **The shelves searched for Marnie's own mark.** Keen Sense live, **natural 36, +3 -> effective 96, Strong**: a **matched earring set** on the third shelf, silverwork with something faintly warm to Flux Sight even at rest, **the clasp stamp unmistakably the same hand as the dagger, the leather piece and the wallet lining seam.** **[A-Rank], unbound, Intelligence +14**, and a passive **Mana regeneration property worked into the silver rather than granted by a Rank table: +15 percentage points at both Section 5.2 rates**, composing as Conduit does. **Finished. Complete. And never collected**, exactly as the ledger's own entry said.

  **A second pass for the pattern itself rather than her mark.** **Natural 55, +3 -> effective 100, Legendary.** Three more pieces carry it:

  - **A ring**, C-Rank on the surface, **Perception +5** - and a **nested working folded inside the visible one**, live rather than latent: **the piece reads as its surface Rank to any instrument or Stat Passive weaker than the one reading it.** A disguise the maker wove in, built by someone who had learned to expect being checked. Mark unrecognised.
  - **A short blade [B-Rank]**, weapon power 11, armed strike x0.85 - and **a passive +1 modifier step on the first strike of any exchange**, worked into the weighting rather than granted by a table. **Same unrecognised mark as the ring** - one maker, two pieces.
  - **A pendant [A-Rank]**, **Vitality +16**, and **the only one of the five whose ceiling Flux Sight reads as already reached.** **Once per day, on the wearer crossing below 25% Health, a single automatic partial heal of 15% of maximum Health** - no action, no cost, no roll. **A finished, armed emergency ward, built to save a life, left on a shelf.** A third distinct mark.

  **Five pieces, four makers, one signature: someone got too good and stopped being useful to control.** **The `2nd time this qtr` note reads very differently standing in front of the proof it was not describing something rare.**

  **All five taken into the dimensional inventory.** The half-finished B-Rank ring blank was **deliberately left** - no maker's mark, mid-commission, an ordinary paying customer's order rather than anything belonging to this pattern.

  **The room read once more, structurally.** **Natural 41, +3 -> effective 100, Legendary.** A section of subfloor near the second exit **reads hollow under poured concrete** - a shallow cavity beneath a paving stone set to look permanent. Inside, one folded sheet in the same hand as the margin note: **a delivery manifest**, addressed nowhere, dated the same week as the earrings' completion entry.

  > *'Collected 3, left 2 - D says the pair's not worth the trip yet. Will reassess next quarter.'*

  **D does not come for everything.** Some completed pieces are collected; some are judged not worth the journey and left. **The earrings were on the wrong side of a cost-benefit call**, which is the one genuinely hopeful fact in the whole thread: **someone weighing value against effort is a very different shape than someone eliminating loose ends.** It also means **the shelf gets reassessed on a quarterly cadence**, and it is now five pieces lighter.

  **Photographed on his own phone** before leaving - the manifest note, legible, the first piece of this thread that exists somewhere other than in a locked unit."
```

  **What is established.** CONSULT controls unlicensed artificers, sells their work anonymously, and tracks them by alias. `COMPLETE` marks a maker proving they no longer need it. D decides what happens next, has done so at least twice this quarter, and does not collect everything. Five confirmed makers, four of them unnamed. Marnie's own case still unresolved either way, and the dagger's finished state argues she completed it **and then** something happened, rather than the reverse.

  **What is not.** Who D is. Where four makers are. Whether *collected* means safety, captivity or worse. And the thing that bites first - **Peter Kwiatkowski now has to explain a missing satchel on Thursday to people who keep a manifest**, and Alexander is the reason he cannot.

  **Practical preparation, bought with cash and no roll.** A long dark weatherproof cloak with a deep hood - reading as someone avoiding recognition on a cold night rather than as costume - and **four prepaid burner phones**, cash, no ID required under the counter's own threshold. **Cash $329,287.22 -> $329,090.22** (approximately $197 the lot).

  **The wallet worked again for a contact number and there is none** - a wallet does not carry its owner's own number. **The expired Coalition membership card remains the live route**: Kesha Morrison's desk holds a number against that member ID. The alternative is the home address, already in hand.

  **No danger occurred anywhere in this span, and nothing was rolled against him at any point.**"

description: "**Batch settlement for `EVT-000699`-`EVT-000711`.**

  **`gatefall.skill_credit`: explicit `none`, and it is the eighth consecutive settlement to classify so.** No dangerous scene occurred anywhere in the span. Nothing acted against Alexander, nothing was rolled against him, and no opponent capable of beating him was present at any point - the Section 7.4 contest test authored at Profile 1.92 fails on its own terms rather than by omission. **Every skill activation this span was reconnaissance, movement, or theft against unaware civilians.** `F-046` stands, and the 2026-08-25 tick's crucible floor is the profile's own answer to it, sitting unentered on the board as `GB-14`.

  **`gatefall.skill_formation`: a candidate opened, and it is the player's own proposal.** Alexander twice withdrew an object directly from another person's possession into the dimensional inventory, unseen, under active concealment - the satchel at `EVT-000708` and the wallet at `EVT-000709`, both Legendary. **Tested against Section 7.1's five gates:**

  1. **Deliberate** - declared by the player both times, not narrative flourish. **Passes.**
  2. **Repeatable signature** - `withdraw-a-carried-object-from-another-person.into-the-dimensional-inventory.under-concealment.without-contact-registering`. Statable, matchable. **Passes.**
  3. **Distinct capability** - the live question. Section 12.9 storage governs **his own** items; Dimensional Projection launches **his own** objects outward. **Neither authors taking a thing out of another person's grip**, and the combination creates a repeatable capability its parts do not grant. **Passes, and is flagged as the test an owner ruling may want to revisit.**
  4. **Material success** - both takes succeeded and both materially contributed: the satchel produced the bracer and the second-maker proof, the wallet produced the identity. **Passes.**
  5. **Distinct scene** - **one continuous pursuit from Loomis Street to Ironclad Self Storage**, and Section 7.1 test 5 credits a continuous sequence **at most once.** So this is **one qualifying scene, not two.**

  **Recorded `tracking` at 1/3** under key `dimensional_theft`, evidence `EVT-000708#satchel-from-the-grip` and `EVT-000709#wallet-under-recast-concealment` bound as one scene reference. **No profile-authored result exists for this candidate**, so should it reach 3/3 it opens the mandatory Section 7.1 adjudication queue rather than resolving automatically - the `formation_instruction` and `reactive_pattern_anticipation` precedent.

  **Trigger audit, dispatched on `scene.opened`, `location.changed` and `clue.established`.**

  - **`gatefall.quest.urgent`: `none`.** The Devon Avenue break sited by the crucible floor satisfies criterion 2 (an active break with creatures loose) and criterion 1's *nearby* - but **Alexander never went, never perceived the threat directly, and criteria 3 and 4 cannot be stated from facts he perceives.** The floor creates conditions, never a quest, exactly as Section 8.4.7 says. **Recorded dry rather than omitted.**
  - **`gatefall.quest.hidden`: ATTACHED - `ENT-000193`, *Who Runs the CONSULT Operation*.** All four Section 8.4.3 criteria hold: the complete `concealed-discovery` record was authored at `EVT-000329`, in an earlier exchange than this audit; **proximity is unambiguous** - he entered the building named in the work order and stood inside the operation's own storage unit; **he does not yet know the concealed fact**, the reveal condition being *who runs it and why it took interest in Marnie*, and D remains a signature with no name; and the reveal, objective, completion and expiry conditions were all recorded before notification. **Capacity available at 2/6.** Reward fixed at the Section 3.4 milestone one Rank above System Rank A - **S-Rank, 6,800 XP** - and not repriced by later leveling. **Renders `[HIDDEN] ???` and nothing else.**

  **Temporal settlement.** Anchor **2026-08-24 10:16 -> 2026-08-25 10:40**, crossing one date boundary and the 06:00 tick. **Health never left cap at any point across the entire span** - nothing landed on him, in either day. **47 Mana spent across the span** against Conduit [S]'s continuous accrual at 35%/hr active on a 2,016 pool; both pools close **full at 4,016/4,016 and 2,016/2,016**, remainders zero.

  **Two ledger repairs and four Runtime corrections, all player-caught, all recorded rather than buried**: the `EVT-000684` naming error; the mana-null disc's abandonment; the auction-floor contest mechanic; rift-step proposed as continuous movement; the under-surfaced Silent Step recast; and the `120_INVENTORY_AND_OWNERSHIP.md` `current_funds` block found stale against the Bulwark purchase.

  **No canonical contradiction found. Promotion barrier passes.**"

The earliest entry is dated eleven days after the March 2016 Damen Avenue Break, before BGM's Chicago field office existed: the writer knew about `ENT-000216`'s arrival before the city had finished counting bodies from a different disaster, and told no one for a decade. The correlation between `ENT-000216`'s and `ENT-000217`'s two pulse faces has been narrowing across the whole run — small, only visible to someone measuring for ten years — with margin annotations shortening to a single repeated word by the final volumes: **faster.** The final volume, the one left open on the desk at `EVT-000675`, stops mid-sentence: a pulse reading that breaks the decade-long pattern in a way the writer's own shorthand has no symbol for, described as an **'independent event'** and never finished — the writer left, ordinarily, roughly ninety minutes before Alexander ever crossed the door, so whatever interrupted the entry was not Alexander's presence. **No name anywhere in any volume.** The texture — a single unbranded, patient, paper-trusting hand — reads *against* the working theory that this is the same operation as `ENT-000192`'s CONSULT staging, which moves product and tracks percentages rather than watching alone for ten years. `ENT-000221`'s `contents` field moves from `unread` to this established account; the writer's identity and the interrupted reading both remain open threads."

## EVT-000736 - Profile 1.100 Readiness: The Slots, the Second Catalog, and Fourteen Re-Derivations

```yaml
id: EVT-000736
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active
provenance:
  source: session-gameplay
  game_date: "2026-08-26T06:00:00-05:00"

    domain: gatefall.skill_formation
    result: none
participation_audits:
  - subject: ENT-000125
    result: record-updated
    record: ENT-000125
description: "**The readiness gate found five things wrong with live state under the newly adopted Profile 1.100, and the owner ruled on all of them.**

  **1. Title slots were stored at 5 and derive to 7.** Section 16.3 makes the count derived from `titles.last_assessment`, never stored — five through level 50, a sixth at 60, a seventh at 80. `last_assessment` reads 90, so both were long since passed and the checkpoint's `slots: 5` was 1.99 law left standing. Corrected to 7. **Godslayer deliberately left unequipped** on the owner's instruction: its passive renders exact remaining Health on every perceived creature, which tells a Bearer at this scale nothing he cannot already infer. Both new slots stand open.

  **2. The second catalog had never been tested.** Section 16.4 opens eleven Ascendant and Absolute titles from the level-60 assessment onward, and the 60/70/80/90 assessments had all run against the twenty-one-entry first catalog only. The migration record's steps 3 and 4 say nothing is granted retroactively and no past assessment is disturbed — **but those steps were written for a campaign standing at level 59 and say so in their own text.** Read literally they would leave four decades untested. **Owner ruling: re-run all four against §16.4.** Nine of eleven fail on established fact — no §9.11 directed assignment has ever occurred, no red gate has ever been entered, district pressure has stood at 0 all campaign, the single §9.1.4 major roll ever made came up *the world holds*, the best assessed-versus-true gap on record is one Rank, thirty of two hundred dailies, no state-directed S-Rank operation, tier IV against tier VII, and `The Ledger's End` is permanently foreclosed by the §19.4 card trade. **One passes: PROVEN** [Ascendant, +15] — one hundred §7.4 qualifying contested scenes across all skills, against 406 already banked. Granted at the **level-60** assessment, where the record first satisfied it. Levels 70, 80 and 90 still grant nothing.

  **The irony is recorded rather than smoothed over:** Proven's passive cuts a combat skill's mastery cost from three qualifying scenes to two, and the Bearer had generated zero qualifying scenes in nineteen consecutive settlements. Two-thirds of nothing is nothing. It became live later the same morning for reasons nobody anticipated at this gate.

  **3. Fourteen skills carried `pending re-derivation` flags** from the `EVT-000729` rune-ascension pass and were resolved in full against §7.2/§7.4 rather than guessed: Mana costs returned to their native-Rank bases (mastery's −10%/level is zero at Novice and Rank never touches cost); Stone Skin and Bulwark both hit the §7.2 90% reduction cap with their dead magnitude steps converting to duration; Dagger Mastery's chassis resolved to **×1.85** (0.10 + 0.25×4), correcting an A-Rank Expert placeholder of ×2.00 that had been inflating both dagger damage lines by roughly 600 each; Twin Fang's follow-up to **×2.40**; Dimensional Projection to 5 projectiles at 17 m. Every category authored at or below S-Rank was confirmed retained under §7.2's retention rule.

  **Mana Bolt was the worst of them and was being computed against a stale B-Rank baseline.** Its line read `(150 + effInt) × 1.90` — 150 is the B-Rank figure, and the skill has stood at S-Rank since `EVT-000727`. The stored `magnitude_floor` of 175 is the authority over the unauthored ×1.90. Corrected to `(1000 + effInt) × 1.75`; the larger baseline more than covers the smaller multiplier and the skill came out **ahead**.

  **4. `riftwalker.anchors.cap` stored 67 against a derived 190** — §18.8 reads the cap live from effective Agility and the stored field had not followed the level 54→93 crossings. This is the eighth recorded recurrence of the `F-037`/`F-048` shape and is noted as such.

  **5. `180_CURRENT_STATE.md`'s Bindings line still read Profile 1.99** while the character sheet, the checkpoint manifest and the active profile all read 1.100.

  **A sixth finding was surfaced and deliberately not repaired here:** `titles_catalog.earned` holds ten entries against fifteen earned titles — Giantslayer, The Unmeasured, Vanguard and Godslayer have no catalogue record, and the `/system titles` panel had to source their passives from `earned_summary` and the profile instead. Proven's own entry is written here. The four pre-existing gaps remain open."
```

## EVT-000737 - The 06:00 Tick, and What GB-14 Actually Was

```yaml
id: EVT-000737
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active
provenance:
  source: session-gameplay

    domain: gatefall.skill_credit
    result: none
    note: "World tick; the Bearer resolved no action."
participation_audits:
  - subject: ENT-000125
    result: no-change
description: "**The Section 9.1 daily world tick, run with real dice before anything else resolved.** Full roll record in `110_WORLD_LEDGER.md`'s `world_ticks`.

  **Crucible floor at `quiet_days` 6** — well past the ≥4 threshold — so the tick owed a guaranteed §9.12 audition on his route, a sited §8.4.2-qualifying crisis within reach, and a doubled anomaly roll on the audition taking the worse result. All discharged.

  **Six Chicago Gates, two Prague.** Two Chicago detections sited `01-10` ON ROUTE. The first is the crucible floor's guaranteed audition; the second rolled its own §9.12 share independently at Combat Tier S's 50% and **also came up an audition.** Both read true Rank **S** and both rolled **Red gate** on the anomaly table — the doubled roll taking the worse on the first, an ordinary roll landing there on the second. Both post to the board as ordinary unconfirmed C-Rank lots that no BGM instrument can see through.

  **And the tick's contest step is where the session actually turned.** `GB-14` — the previous tick's audition, still unentered — rolled **24 against a C-Rank take rate of 55% and was TAKEN by the trade.** An Ironline crew of twelve, floor-compliant, all licences current, filed clean, took a confirmed-looking C-Rank Lakefront lot off the board and entered it around 19:00 the previous evening.

  **OWNER RULING, and it reverses a Runtime error made in the same breath as the roll.** The Runtime first narrated GB-14 as *cleared* by that crew — reasoning that §9.12 keys an audition's true Rank to the Bearer, so a Gate nobody-relevant entered resolves as its assessment. **The player ruled that wrong and the ruling stands: an audition's true Rank is objective Gate state, fixed when the tick instantiates it, not a property that waits on who walks through the mouth.** The Gate rolled S-Rank and Red gate at 06:00. Twelve C-Rank-capable hunters walked into an S-Rank interior that sealed behind them. **Ten died. Two did not.**

  A red gate does not open until its boss dies, so nothing about this was visible from outside — no radio, no return, no way to confirm anything was wrong. Guild ops flagged the missed check-in around midnight; families began being notified after that.

  **Desmond Farraday (`ENT-000223`) activated the standing incident-responder arrangement** (`EVT-000684`) at 04:00, calling repeatedly and reaching nothing — Alexander was asleep and the phone was face-down on a balcony table. He did not authorise in-person contact, on the reasoning that the arrangement was negotiated *declinable, case by case* specifically so it would not become an obligation with teeth, and that sending someone to a private citizen's door before dawn would convert it into something else. That decision cost two hours and is examined again at `EVT-000744`."
```

Inside, the crew's support gear sat staged in a half-circle exactly as abandoned mid-motion — packs, an unused coiled rope, a zipped medic kit, a comms unit still powered and carrying open static.

  **Flux Sight read the mouth before he crossed it: `[S-Rank] confirmed by capability`.** No roll, no cost, no declaration — a Stat Passive reads on sight (§4.4). The board said C. The contract said C. The posting floor that put twelve people inside said C. **What was actually there read S, instantly and unambiguously, and no instrument BGM owns could see it.**

  He took command of the cordon before entering — everyone back, nobody inside, medics and menders staged, Farraday called — then crossed. **The seal closed behind him. No retreat until the boss died.**

  **The interior is a Flooded Mine archetype (🎲 d8 3), alien-first**: ankle-deep standing water over ground nobody poured, timber shoring cut from wood that grows nowhere on Earth, water that smells of nothing and was fed by no rain this world has made.

  **Flux Sight rendered the room in one window:** eleven S-Rank commons (4,000 HP each), two S-Rank elites (8,000 each), one S-Rank boss (16,000) — the standard §9.7 population, 🎲 3d6 11 commons and 🎲 1d2 2 elites — and, sixty yards off in a collapsed side-tunnel, **two hunters still alive.** **Marta Ilić (`ENT-000231`), C-Rank, 61/250 Health.** **Devon Achebe (`ENT-000232`), C-Rank, 118/250, semi-conscious.** Out of the boss's line, staying that way on stillness and luck.

  ```text
  URGENT QUEST OFFER - A Way Out of the Flood
  Objective   Reach Marta Ilić and Devon Achebe and get them clear
  Reward      6,800 XP
  Failure     The boss or an elite reaches the tunnel first
  ```

  **Accepted.** Keen Sense read a clean lane (whole-scene, 1 Mana); **Sprint** (3) and **Flash Step** (8) crossed the flooded floor and closed the gap; an in-scene **rift-step** (1) dropped him inside the tunnel before either elite finished turning toward the disturbance. No roll on any of it — effective Agility 3,945 against an S-Rank domain rating of 60 leaves no genuine uncertainty under §4.2.

  **Bulwark** (10 Mana) went up over all three of them at its re-derived **90%** reduction, `Covering the line` extending it to every ally within reach rather than forcing a choice. **Mend cast twice** (6 each) at the S-Rank baseline of 1,000 — far past either survivor's maximum — restoring **Marta 61→250** and **Devon 118→250**, both to full. Neither had words for it. A wound simply closing under torn, blood-stiff clothing does not have an ordinary explanation.

  Out in the gallery, one of the elites stopped moving, then turned toward the tunnel mouth and started forward — not guessing anymore."

  **Mana Bolt, 🎲 d100 90, +2 steps → effective 100, critical.** `(1000 + 4207) × 1.75 × 4` = **35,126 against an 8,000 pool.** It went through the chest cavity and took a section of the far wall with it. The elite never raised whatever it was raising.

  **And this is where the session's central mechanical question surfaced.** The Runtime settled that kill as **non-qualifying** under §7.4's *a beast he deletes before it acts does not [qualify]* — the clause that exists precisely to close this loophole. **The player challenged the finding on a structural argument, and the argument is correct:** the Bearer's output has scaled so far past even confirmed S-Rank Health that *nothing this profile can generate survives to complete a second exchange against him.* The contest test, as written, had become unsatisfiable for this character regardless of what he fought — not a smaller `F-046`, but the same defect surviving its own fix.

  **OWNER RULING, recorded as a provisional mechanic under Data Model §7.10 and owed to Profile Section 7.4:** *confirmed S-Rank content, a §9.6 red gate, or any §9.6 anomaly satisfies §7.4's contest-test conditions 1 and 2 — an opponent who could beat him, and a real resolution against him — on confirmed engagement alone. It no longer needs to survive long enough to swing back. Condition 3, a cost on failure, still has to hold on its own terms.* Tonight it does: Marta and Devon are one landed hit from dead without him standing where he is standing. **Owed to §7.4 for formal authorship; the grant concedes capability and consequence, never magnitude.**

## EVT-000744 - Farraday, and the Two Hours

```yaml
id: EVT-000744

  - subject: ENT-000223
    result: record-updated
    record: ENT-000223
description: "**Alexander refused to negotiate the arrival.** Farraday asked him to land outside the building and walk the last fifty feet — not from doubt, but because BGM security's entire job is reacting to an unexplained presence in a secure federal space. Alexander said no, flatly: the only courtesy on offer was a direct arrival to Farraday's own office, and *if you wanted to meet me without me making trouble for your system, you should have come here.* He had stayed at the scene for hours to make sure ten bodies were handled properly.

  **Farraday took it rather than argue**, asked for ten minutes to clear it with his own people properly instead of as an afterthought, and said — quieter — *I'd have come to you. I said that badly the first time. It wasn't ever really about the hallway.* Ten minutes later the rift-step landed in his office with no alarm and no drawn weapons.

  **Alexander opened by refusing the framing.** He is not BGM's personnel. He cleared an S-Rank Gate alone and saved two hunters because they asked. There was no gratitude and no compensation, and the arrangement he signed said compensated.

  **Farraday conceded all of it without hedging:** compensation owed, a figure by end of day, *and it won't be an insult.* He had let it slide behind two other priorities and said so.

  **On the two hours between the missed check-in and the first call**, he gave the machinery honestly rather than defending it: a late crew is not a confirmed emergency at midnight, the escalation went up a chain and came back down before anyone was authorised to wake an unaffiliated S-Rank citizen at four in the morning. **On why nobody was sent to the door:** he has no standing to. The arrangement was negotiated *declinable, case by case*, and authorising a pre-dawn visit to a private citizen would have converted it into something Alexander would have been right to end on the spot.

  **On why no other S-Rank was called:** there is another in the region. She is on no arrangement with this office, has no standing terms and no precedent, and reaching her cold at 04:00 for what still read as an ordinary bad night would have been asking a stranger to drop everything. *That's not a good enough answer. It's the true one.*

  **Alexander gave him the thing he had not asked for:** if lives are involved, send someone to knock. He can still say no — but he would not.

  **THE ARRANGEMENT IS AMENDED** (extends `EVT-000684`): in a **confirmed life-threatening emergency**, BGM may attempt in-person contact if calls go unanswered within a bounded window. Compensation terms fold into the same document. Both owed in writing by end of day, for Alexander to read and confirm it says what he meant.

  **And Alexander raised what the incident actually exposes**: the S-Ranks need to cooperate, and nothing exists to make that possible. Farraday cannot call that meeting — Region V coordinates a metro, not a national body — and what exists nationally is the Draft framework, built to *move* S-Ranks at a crisis and never to let them talk outside one. He will file a formal request up his own chain naming this incident as the case: an assessment failure BGM's instruments could not catch, resolved only because one S-Rank happened to be reachable and willing.

  **He also owes an introduction.** Alexander has been carded S-Rank for three days and **nobody from BGM National has contacted him** — a gap Farraday called either a backlog or the same class of failure that let a Gate's Rank lie to every instrument in the building. He will make the call to a named contact at the **S-Rank Liaison Office** personally rather than hand over a switchboard number."
```

## EVT-000748 - Ledger Repair: The Floor That Was Never Written, and a Dropped Increment

```yaml
id: EVT-000748
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.7"
status: active
provenance:
  source: session-gameplay
  game_date: "2026-08-26T13:30:00-05:00"
  real_date: "2026-08-26"
type: Event
kind: system
importance: major
game_date: "2026-08-26 13:30 -05:00"
participants:
  - ENT-000125
counter_deltas:
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.dimensional_projection.magnitude_floor, delta: 21 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.exploit_pattern.mastery_progress, delta: 1 }
progression_audits:
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_credit
    result: none
  - subject: ENT-000125
    domain: gatefall.skill_formation
    result: none
participation_audits:
  - subject: ENT-000125
    result: record-updated
    record: ENT-000125
description: "**Two defects recorded at the checkpoint 0124 barrier, repaired immediately after it on the player's instruction.** No fictional time passes, no scene resolves, and nothing about the campaign's narrative moves; this is the ledger being made to agree with rules that were already in force.

  **1. `skills.dimensional_projection.magnitude_floor`: 0 -> 21.** Section 7.2's magnitude ratchet requires the floor to be written as a `counter_deltas` change **on the ascension Event itself**, recording the skill's own authored magnitude immediately before that ascension. The `EVT-000729` rune-ascension pass wrote it for no skill, and Dimensional Projection is the one where it mattered: its range is owned by mastery, and ascension resets mastery.

  **The pre-ascension value is not reconstructed by inference — it is read.** `saves/900_CHECKPOINT_0122/100_CHARACTER_SHEET.md` carries the line verbatim: *Dimensional Projection [C-Rank] Expert, Mana 4, **5 projectiles, range 21 m***. That is the immutable capture taken before `EVT-000729` resolved, so the floor is 21 as a matter of record rather than judgment.

  **The consequence, and it reverses the finding written into the barrier.** The authored value at [S-Rank] Novice is 5 projectiles and **17 m** (5 base + 3 m per Rank above native, four Ranks). Against a floor of 21, `magnitude = max(17, 21)` — **the floor binds and the skill holds 21 m.** Projectiles tie at 5 either way. So the ascension cost him no reach at all, which is exactly what the ratchet exists to guarantee and exactly what the missing floor had failed to state. **Everything resolved with this skill this session stands**: both volleys were thrown well inside 17 m, so no roll, no damage figure and no outcome changes.

  **Section 7.2's dividend clause 1 is not applied here.** It raises a binding floor by the skill's own per-level increment on a mastery advance, and names three increments — a damage multiplier, a reduction fraction, a granted multiplier. Dimensional Projection's axis is projectile count and range, and its Section 7.4 dividend row reads *none needed — projectiles and range are his own*. There is no authored increment to apply, so the floor holds flat rather than being given an invented one.

  **2. `skills.exploit_pattern.mastery_progress`: 0 -> 1.** Exploit Pattern materially contributed to a qualifying scene at `EVT-000742` — the legendary read (natural 84, effective 100) that established the funnel-hesitation Pattern the whole pack volley was aimed through. `qualifying_scenes_total` was credited to 50 and `successful_uses` to 90, and **the mastery increment was dropped.**

  **This is the `F-012` shape and it is worth naming as such.** The skill sat at Expert with progress showing 0/3; crediting the scene without advancing progress leaves a record that is well-formed, internally consistent, and passes every arithmetic gate — because a delta that is never claimed can never disagree with a stored value. It was caught by the player asking whether the progression had actually been counted, which is the same way `F-012` was caught the first time.

  **No mastery level advanced this session.** With Proven **dormant**, the Section 7.4 rate stands at three qualifying scenes per level. After this repair the standing is: Mana Bolt **2/3**, Dimensional Projection **2/3**, and Rupture, Flash Step, Dagger Mastery, Twin Fang, Silent Step, Bulwark, Sprint and Exploit Pattern all **1/3**. Nothing reached three.

  **And that leaves a live decision the Bearer has not made.** Proven's passive is *a combat skill advances a mastery level on two qualifying scenes instead of three*. **Equipping it into either of the two open title slots would immediately advance both Mana Bolt and Dimensional Projection**, each of which now stands at exactly two.   **The Gate Walker trial entered on the spot.** Six-phase form (1.102's own ruling, since the evolution stood uncleared), Combat Tier S throughout (System Rank floor already at the cap), Flooded Mine archetype rolled fresh (d8, 3). Resource rule live: no potion, no claimed Status Recovery, no elapsed-time recovery for the duration.

  **Phase 1, the folded-in evolution examination.** A combined Keen Sense/Flux Sight/Exploit Pattern read of the entry gallery rolled a natural 94, net +3 (Perception margin +2 capped, Keen Sense's own step +1), effective 100, Legendary success. A trial-local anchor set there (free, uncontested, per 1.103's later fix legal apparatus rather than the barred general case). Left the platform, a manufactured disturbance fired at the anchor per the anchor sense's own authored behavior, answered same-exchange by an anchored step (unrestricted, flat 5 Mana) — the deed's apparatus proven inside the seal, though the outdoor deed itself remains unperformed and now moot for unlock purposes.

  **Phase 2, The Converging.** 4d6 commons (rolled 10) at Rank A (Combat Tier minus one), arriving in 1d3+1 groups (rolled 4, sized 2/4/1/3) from different bearings, overlapping rather than queuing. Group 1 (2): Dimensional Projection volley, natural 82 net +1 (Agility margin +2 capped, Flooded Mine -1), effective 100, Legendary, both killed clean. Group 2 (4): Dimensional Projection, natural 65 net +1, effective 85, Strong, all four killed. Group 3 (1): Mana Bolt fumbled (natural 5, critical tail, no modifier removes it) — the bolt discharged short, the common closed and landed a hit, 375 raw x (1-0.90 Bulwark) = 37 to Health; Rupture then killed it clean, natural 37 net +2, effective 77, Success. Group 4 (3): Dimensional Projection, natural 33 net +1, effective 53, Partial, all three killed, one landing a hit before dying (37 more, Bulwark-reduced). It links within the far side (to the stratum's entry seam), same as any two places he's stood; confirmed this span that it does **not** bridge back to Earth — the far door remains the sole authored crossing (`worlds/gatefall/270_THE_FAR_SIDE.md`'s own header: 'reachable by the far door... and by nothing else authored')."
```
